Theory TD.TD_side

section ‹TD side›

theory TD_side
  imports Basics_side Destabilization_side
begin

declare fun_upd_apply[simp del]


subsection ‹Definition of the Solver Algorithm With Parameterized Destabilization Function›

record ('x,'g,'d) state =
  called :: "'x set"
  infl :: "('x + 'g, 'x list) fmap"
  stabl :: "'x set"
  σ :: "'x + 'g ⇒'d"

locale TD_side =
  fixes destab :: "'x + 'g ⇒ ('x + 'g, 'x list) fmap ⇒ 'x set ⇒ 'x set
                   ⇒ ('x + 'g, 'x list) fmap × 'x set"
    and abort :: "bool"
    and T :: "('x,'g,'d::bounded_semilattice_sup_bot) eqsT"
  assumes destab_removes: "(i2,s2) = destab x i1 s1 c1 ⟹ s2 ⊆ s1"
begin

function (domintros)
    query :: "'x ⇒ 'x ⇒ ('x,'g,'d) state ⇒
              'd × ('x,'g,'d) state" and
  iterate :: "'x ⇒ ('x,'g,'d) state ⇒ 'd × ('x,'g,'d) state" and
   repeat :: "'x ⇒ ('x,'g,'d) state ⇒ 'd × ('x,'g,'d) state" and
     eval :: "'x ⇒ ('x,'g,'d) strategy_tree ⇒ ('x,'g,'d) state ⇒ 'd × ('x,'g,'d) state" where
  "query x y state = (
    let (xd, state) =
      if y ∈ (called state) then
        ((σ state) (Inl y), state)
      else
        iterate y (state ⦇called := insert y (called state)⦈)
    in (xd, state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inl y) x⦈))"
| "iterate x state = (
    if x ∉ (stabl state) then
      let (d_new, state) = repeat x state in
      if (σ state) (Inl x) = d_new then
        (d_new, state⦇called := called state - {x} ⦈)
      else
        let (infl', stabl') = destab (Inl x) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state) in
        iterate x (state ⦇infl := infl', stabl := stabl', σ := (σ state)(Inl x := d_new) ⦈)
    else
      ((σ state) (Inl x), state⦇called := called state - {x} ⦈))"
| "repeat x state = (
    let (d_new, state) = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) in
    if x ∈ stabl state then (d_new, state)
    else repeat x state)"
| "eval x t state =
    (if ¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state then
    (case t of
      Answer d ⇒ (d, state)
    | QueryL y g ⇒ (
        let (yd, state) = query x y state in eval x (g yd) state)
    | QueryG y g ⇒ (
        let yd = (σ state) (Inr y) in
        eval x (g yd) (state ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈))
    | Side y d t ⇒ (
        let d' = (σ state) (Inr y) ⊔ d in
        if (σ state) (Inr y) = d' then eval x t state
        else
          let (infl', stabl') = destab (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state) in
          eval x t (state ⦇infl := infl', stabl := stabl', σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d') ⦈)))
    else ((σ state) (Inl x), state))"
  by pat_completeness auto

definition init_state :: "('x,'g,'d) state" where
  "init_state = ⦇ called = {}, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, σ = (λ_. ⊥) ⦈"

definition solve :: "'x ⇒ 'x set × ('x + 'g ⇒ 'd)" where
  "solve x = (let (d, state) = iterate x (init_state ⦇ called := insert x (called init_state) ⦈) in
  (stabl state, σ state))"

definition query_dom where
  "query_dom y x state = query_iterate_repeat_eval_dom (Inl (Inl (y, x, state)))"
declare query_dom_def [simp]
definition iterate_dom where
  "iterate_dom x state = query_iterate_repeat_eval_dom (Inl (Inr (x, state)))"
declare iterate_dom_def [simp]
definition repeat_dom where
  "repeat_dom x state = query_iterate_repeat_eval_dom (Inr (Inl (x, state)))"
declare repeat_dom_def [simp]
definition eval_dom where
  "eval_dom x t state = query_iterate_repeat_eval_dom (Inr (Inr (x, t, state)))"
declare eval_dom_def [simp]

definition solve_dom where
  "solve_dom x = iterate_dom x (init_state ⦇ called := insert x (called init_state) ⦈)"

lemmas dom_defs = query_dom_def iterate_dom_def repeat_dom_def eval_dom_def


subsection ‹Refinement of auto-generated rules›

text ‹The auto-generated \texttt{pinduct} rule contains a redundant assumption. This lemma removes
this redundant assumption such that the rule is easier to instantiate and gives comprehensible
names to the cases.›

lemmas query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct[consumes 1, case_names Query Iterate Repeat Eval]
  = query_iterate_repeat_eval.pinduct(1)[
      folded dom_defs,
      of x y state for x y state
    ]
    query_iterate_repeat_eval.pinduct(2)[
      folded dom_defs,
      of x state for x state
    ]
    query_iterate_repeat_eval.pinduct(3)[
      folded dom_defs,
      of x state for x state
    ]
    query_iterate_repeat_eval.pinduct(4)[
      folded dom_defs,
      of x t state for x t state
    ]

lemmas iterate_pinduct[consumes 1, case_names Iterate]
  = query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct(2)[where ?P="λy x state. True"
    and ?R="λx state. True" and ?S="λx t state. True", simplified (no_asm_use),
    folded dom_defs]

declare query.psimps[simp] iterate.psimps[simp] repeat.psimps[simp] eval.psimps[simp]


subsection ‹Domain Lemmas›

lemma dom_backwards_pinduct:
  shows "query_dom x y state
    ⟹ y ∉ called state ⟹ iterate_dom y (state ⦇called := insert y (called state)⦈)"
  and "iterate_dom x state
    ⟹ x ∉ (stabl state) ⟹
         repeat_dom x state
          ∧ ((xd_new1, state1) = repeat x state
          ⟶ (σ state1) (Inl x) ≠ xd_new1
          ⟶ (infl2, stabl2) = destab (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1)
          ⟶ iterate_dom x (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
              σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new1)⦈))"
  and "repeat_dom x state ⟹
        eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) ∧
        ((d', state') = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)
        ⟶ x ∉ stabl state' ⟶ repeat_dom x state')"
  and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state ⟶ t = QueryL y g ⟶ query_dom x y state ∧
          ((yd, state') = query x y state ⟶ eval_dom x (g yd) state')) ∧
        (¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state ⟶ t = QueryG z h ⟶ zd = (σ state) (Inr z) ⟶
          eval_dom x (h zd) (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr z) x⦈)) ∧
        (¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state ⟶ t = Side u d t' ⟶ d' = (σ state) (Inr u) ⊔ d ⟶
          (((σ state) (Inr u) = d' ⟶ eval_dom x t' state)
          ∧ ((σ state) (Inr u) ≠ d' ⟶
            (infl1, stabl1) = destab (Inr u) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state) ⟶
            eval_dom x t' (state ⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1,
              σ := (σ state)(Inr u := d')⦈))))"
proof (induction x y state and x state and x state and x t state
    arbitrary: and xd_new1 state1 infl2 stabl2 and d' state'
               and y g yd d z h zd u t' d' state' infl1 stabl1
    rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case
    apply (rule query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs])
    using Query.IH(2)[OF Query.prems]
    by simp+
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  show ?case
    apply (intro impI conjI)
    subgoal
      apply (rule query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(3)[folded dom_defs])
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Iterate.prems] by fastforce+
    subgoal
      apply (rule query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs destab.simps])
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF Iterate.prems, folded dom_defs] by simp+
    done
next
  case (Repeat x state)
  show ?case
    apply (intro impI conjI)
    subgoal
      apply (rule query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(4)[folded dom_defs])
      using Repeat.IH(2)[OF Repeat.prems] by (fastforce split: prod.splits)+
    subgoal
      apply (rule query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(3)[folded dom_defs])
      using Repeat.IH(3)[OF Repeat.prems] by fastforce+
    done
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case
    apply (intro impI conjI)
    subgoal
      apply (rule query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(1)[folded dom_defs])
      using Eval.IH(2) by simp
    subgoal
      apply (rule query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(4)[folded dom_defs])
      using Eval.IH(3) by (fastforce split: prod.splits)+
    subgoal
      apply (rule query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(4)[folded dom_defs])
      using Eval.IH(4) by (fastforce split: prod.splits)+
    subgoal
      apply (rule query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(4)[folded dom_defs])
      using Eval.IH(5) by (fastforce split: prod.splits)+
    subgoal
      apply (rule query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(4)[folded dom_defs])
      using Eval.IH(6) by (fastforce split: prod.splits)+
    done
qed


subsection ‹Case Rules›

lemma iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases[consumes 3]:
  assumes "iterate_dom x state"
    and "(xd, state') = iterate x state"
  obtains (Stable) "state' = state⦇called := called state - {x} ⦈"
    and "(σ state) (Inl x) = xd"
    and "x ∈ stabl state"
  | (Fixpoint) state1
  where "repeat_dom x state"
    and "(xd, state1) = repeat x state"
    and "(σ state1) (Inl x) = xd"
    and "x ∉ stabl state"
    and "state' = state1⦇called := called state1 - {x} ⦈"
  | (Continue) state1 xd_new infl2 stabl2
  where "repeat_dom x state"
    and "(xd_new, state1) = repeat x state"
    and "(σ state1) (Inl x) ≠ xd_new"
    and "(infl2, stabl2) = destab (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1)"
    and "iterate_dom x (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state') = iterate x
          (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)⦈)"
    and "x ∉ stabl state"
proof(cases "x ∈ stabl state" rule: case_split[case_names Stable Unstable])
  case Stable
  then show ?thesis using that(1) assms by auto
next
  case Unstable
  have repeat_dom: "repeat_dom x state"
    using dom_backwards_pinduct(2)[OF assms(1) Unstable]
    by simp
  then obtain xd_new state1 where repeat: "(xd_new, state1) = repeat x state"
    by (cases "repeat x state") auto
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "(σ state1) (Inl x) = xd_new")
    case True
    then have "xd_new = xd" and "state1⦇called := called state1 - {x} ⦈ = state'"
      using assms(1) Unstable repeat assms(2)
      by (cases "repeat x state", simp)+
    then show ?thesis
      using Unstable assms repeat that(2)[OF repeat_dom] True by blast
  next
    case False
    then obtain infl2 stabl2 where destab:
        "(infl2, stabl2) = destab (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1)"
      by (cases "destab (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1)") simp
    then have iterate_dom: "iterate_dom x (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
        σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)⦈)"
      using Unstable False repeat assms(1-2) dom_backwards_pinduct(2)
      by simp
    have iterate: "(xd, state') = iterate x (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
        σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)⦈)"
      using iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] Unstable repeat False
        destab assms(2) by (auto split: prod.split)
    show ?thesis
      using that(3)[OF repeat_dom repeat False destab iterate_dom iterate
          Unstable]
      by simp
  qed
qed

lemma repeat_unstable_stable_cases [consumes 2]:
  assumes "repeat_dom x state"
    and "(d', state') = repeat x state"
  obtains (Unstable) state1 d1
  where "eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(d1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "x ∉ stabl state1"
    and "repeat_dom x state1"
    and "(d', state') = repeat x state1"
  | (Stable) "eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(d', state') = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "x ∈ stabl state'"
proof -
  have eval_dom: "eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using dom_backwards_pinduct(3)[OF assms(1)] by simp
  obtain d1 state1 where eval:
    "(d1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    by (cases "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") auto
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "x ∈ stabl state1" rule: case_split[case_names Stable Unstable])
    case Stable
    show ?thesis
      apply (rule that(2)[OF eval_dom])
      using Stable eval assms(2) repeat.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)]
      by (cases "eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)", simp)+
  next
    case Unstable
    show ?thesis
      apply (rule that(1)[OF eval_dom eval])
      subgoal using Unstable by simp
      subgoal using dom_backwards_pinduct(3)[OF assms(1)] eval Unstable by simp
      subgoal
        using repeat.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] eval Unstable assms(2)
        by (cases "eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") simp
      done
  qed
qed

lemma query_iterate_lookup_cases_basic [consumes 2]:
  assumes "query_dom y x state"
    and "(xd, state') = query y x state"
  obtains (Iterate) state1
  where "iterate_dom x (state⦇called := insert x (called state) ⦈)"
    and "(xd, state1) = iterate x (state⦇called := insert x (called state) ⦈)"
    and "state' = state1 ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state1) (Inl x) y⦈"
    and "x ∉ called state"
  | (Lookup) "(σ state) (Inl x) = xd"
    and "state' = state ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inl x) y⦈"
    and "x ∈ called state"
proof (cases "x ∈ called state")
  case True
  show ?thesis using assms True by (auto intro: that(2))
next
  case False
  obtain xd1 state1 where iterate: "(xd1, state1) = iterate x (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
    by (cases "iterate x (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)") simp
  then have "xd1 = xd"
    using assms False by (auto split: prod.splits)
  show ?thesis
    apply (rule that(1)[of state1])
    using dom_backwards_pinduct(1)[OF assms(1) False] assms(1,2) iterate False ‹xd1 = xd›
    by (simp split: if_splits prod.splits)+
qed

lemma eval_query_answer_cases_basic [consumes 2]:
  assumes "eval_dom x t state"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x t state"
  obtains (QueryL) y g yd state1
  where "¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state"
    and "t = QueryL y g"
    and "query_dom x y state"
    and "(yd, state1) = query x y state"
    and "eval_dom x (g yd) state1"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x (g yd) state1"
  | (QueryG) y g yd
  where "¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state"
    and "t = QueryG y g"
    and "yd = (σ state) (Inr y)"
    and "eval_dom x (g yd) (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x (g yd) (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
  | (Side_Subsumed) y yd d' t1
  where "¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state"
    and "t = Side y yd t1"
    and "d' = (σ state) (Inr y) ⊔ yd"
    and "(σ state) (Inr y) = d'"
    and "eval_dom x t1 state"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x t1 state"
  | (Side_Effect) y yd d' t1 infl1 stabl1
  where "¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state"
    and "t = Side y yd t1"
    and "d' = (σ state) (Inr y) ⊔ yd"
    and "(σ state) (Inr y) ≠ d'"
    and "(infl1, stabl1) = destab (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state)"
    and "eval_dom x t1 (state ⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
    and "(xd, state') =
          eval x t1 (state ⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
  | (Answer) "¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state"
    and "t = Answer xd"
    and "state' = state"
  | (Abort) "abort ∧ x ∉ stabl state"
    and "xd = (σ state) (Inl x)"
    and "state' = state"
proof (cases "¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state")
  assume Stabl : "¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state"
  then show ?thesis
  proof (cases t)
    case (Answer d)
    then show ?thesis using that eval.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] assms(2) Stabl by auto
  next
    case (QueryL y g)
    obtain yd1 state1 where query_y: "(yd1, state1) = query x y state"
      by (cases "query x y state", simp)
    have query_y_dom: "query_dom x y state"
      using dom_backwards_pinduct(4)[OF assms(1), THEN conjunct1, folded
            atomize_imp, OF _ QueryL, of yd1 state1] Abort Stabl by simp
    have "(xd, state') = eval x (g yd1) state1"
      using eval.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] QueryL query_y assms(2) Stabl
      by (auto split: prod.splits)
    then show ?thesis
      using that(1) QueryL query_y_dom query_y dom_backwards_pinduct(4) assms Stabl by fast
  next
    case (QueryG y g)
    obtain yd1 where query_y: "yd1 = (σ state) (Inr y)" by simp
    have "(xd, state') = eval x (g yd1) (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
      using eval.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] QueryG query_y assms(2) Stabl
      by (auto split: prod.splits)
    then show ?thesis
      using QueryG query_y dom_backwards_pinduct(4)[OF assms(1)] that(2) Stabl
      by (auto intro: that(2))
  next
    case (Side y d t)
    define d' where "d' = (σ state) (Inr y) ⊔ d"
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "(σ state) (Inr y) = d'")
      case True
      then have eval: "(xd, state') = eval x t state"
        using eval.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] Side d'_def assms(2) Stabl
        by (auto simp add: Let_def split: prod.splits)
      then show ?thesis
        using True Side d'_def dom_backwards_pinduct(4)[OF assms(1)] Stabl
        by (auto intro: that(3)[OF _ Side d'_def]
            simp add: Side_Subsumed TD_side.eval_dom_def TD_side_axioms eval)
    next
      case False
      obtain infl1 stabl1 where
        destab: "(infl1, stabl1) = destab (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state)"
        by (cases "destab (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state)") simp
      then have eval: "(xd, state') =
          eval x t (state ⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
        using eval.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] Side d'_def assms(2) False Stabl
        by (auto simp add: Let_def split: prod.splits)
      then show ?thesis
        using False destab Side d'_def dom_backwards_pinduct(4)[OF assms(1)] Stabl
        by (auto intro: that(4)[OF Stabl Side d'_def]
            simp add: Side_Subsumed TD_side.eval_dom_def TD_side_axioms eval)
    qed
  qed
next
  case False
  then show ?thesis using that eval.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF assms(1)] assms(2) by force
qed


lemma c_same:
  shows
    "query_dom x y state ⟹ (xd, state') = query x y state ⟹ called state' = called state"
    "iterate_dom x state ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state ⟹ called state' = called state - {x}"
    "repeat_dom x state ⟹ (xd, state') = repeat x state ⟹ called state' = called state"
    "eval_dom x t state ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state ⟹ called state' = called state"
proof (induction x y state and x state and x state and x t state
       arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
       rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query x y state)
  show ?case using Query(1,3)
  proof (cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases_basic)
    case (Iterate state1)
    then show ?thesis using Query(2)[of xd state1] by simp
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis by fastforce
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  show ?case using Iterate(1,4)
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case Fixpoint
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2) by simp
  next
    case (Continue state1 xd_new infl⇩L2 stabl2)
    then show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(7,2)]
        Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(7,2) _ _ Continue(4) _ Continue(6)]
      by simp
  qed
next
  case (Repeat x state)
  show ?case using Repeat(1,4)
  proof (cases rule: repeat_unstable_stable_cases)
    case (Unstable state1 d1)
    show ?thesis
      using Repeat.IH(2)[OF Unstable(2)] Repeat.IH(3)[OF Unstable(2) _ Unstable(3,5)] by simp
  next
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis using Repeat.IH(2)[OF Stable(2)] by simp
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval(1,7)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases_basic)
    case (QueryL y g yd state1)
    show ?thesis
      using Eval.IH(2)[OF QueryL(1,2,4)] Eval.IH(3)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) _ QueryL(6)] by simp
  next
    case (QueryG y g yd)
    then show ?thesis using Eval.IH(4)[OF QueryG(1,2,3,5)] by simp
  next
    case (Side_Subsumed y yd d' t1)
    then show ?thesis
      using Eval.IH(5)[OF Side_Subsumed(1,2,3) _ Side_Subsumed(6)] Side_Subsumed(4)
      by (simp split: if_splits prod.splits)
  next
    case (Side_Effect y yd d' t1 infl1 stabl1)
    then show ?thesis
      using Eval.IH(6)[OF Side_Effect(1,2,3) _ _ _ Side_Effect(7)]
      by (cases "destab (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state)") auto
  qed fast+
qed

lemma iterate_fmlookup:
  assumes "iterate_dom x state"
    and "(xd, state') = iterate x state"
  shows "(σ state') (Inl x) = xd"
  using assms
proof(induction x state rule: iterate_pinduct)
  case (Iterate x state)
  show ?case
    using Iterate.hyps Iterate.prems
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case Fixpoint
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case (Continue state1 xd_new infl⇩L2 stabl2)
    then show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(1) c_same(3)[OF Continue(1,2)] Iterate(3) by fastforce
  qed
qed

corollary query_fmlookup:
  assumes "query_dom y x state"
    and "(xd, state') = query y x state"
  shows "(σ state') (Inl x) = xd"
  using assms iterate_fmlookup[OF dom_backwards_pinduct(1)[OF assms(1)]]
  by (auto split: prod.splits if_splits)

lemma eval_query_answer_cases [consumes 2]:
  assumes "eval_dom x t state"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x t state"
  obtains (QueryL) y g yd state1
  where "¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state"
    and "t = QueryL y g"
    and "query_dom x y state"
    and "(yd, state1) = query x y state"
    and "eval_dom x (g yd) state1"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x (g yd) state1"
    and "(σ state1) (Inl y) = yd"
  | (QueryG) y g yd
  where "¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state"
    and "t = QueryG y g"
    and "yd = (σ state) (Inr y)"
    and "eval_dom x (g yd) (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x (g yd) (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
  | (Side_Subsumed) y yd d' t1
  where "¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state"
    and "t = Side y yd t1"
    and "d' = (σ state) (Inr y) ⊔ yd"
    and "(σ state) (Inr y) = d'"
    and "eval_dom x t1 state"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x t1 state"
  | (Side_Effect) y yd d' t1 infl1 stabl1
  where "¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state"
    and "t = Side y yd t1"
    and "d' = (σ state) (Inr y) ⊔ yd"
    and "(σ state) (Inr y) ≠ d'"
    and "(infl1, stabl1) = destab (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state)"
    and "eval_dom x t1 (state ⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
    and "(xd, state') =
          eval x t1 (state ⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
  | (Answer) "¬ abort ∨ x ∈ stabl state"
    and "t = Answer xd"
    and "state' = state"
  | (Abort) "abort ∧ x ∉ stabl state"
    and "xd = (σ state) (Inl x)"
    and "state' = state"
  apply (rule eval_query_answer_cases_basic[OF assms])
  apply (simp add: query_fmlookup[of x _ state])
  by metis+

lemma query_iterate_lookup_cases [consumes 2]:
  assumes "query_dom y x state"
    and "(xd, state') = query y x state"
  obtains (Iterate) state1
  where "iterate_dom x (state⦇called := insert x (called state) ⦈)"
    and "(xd, state1) = iterate x (state⦇called := insert x (called state) ⦈)"
    and "state' = state1 ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state1) (Inl x) y⦈"
    and "(σ state') (Inl x) = xd"
    and "x ∉ called state"
  | (Lookup) "(σ state) (Inl x) = xd"
    and "state' = state ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inl x) y⦈"
    and "x ∈ called state"
  apply (rule query_iterate_lookup_cases_basic[OF assms])
  using iterate_fmlookup[of x "state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈"]
  by (simp_all split: if_splits del: dom_defs)


subsection ‹Basic Properties of the Solver State›

lemma called_value_unchanged:
  shows "query_dom x y state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = query x y state
    ⟹ ∀x ∈ called state. (σ state) (Inl x) = (σ state') (Inl x)"
    and "iterate_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state
    ⟹ ∀x ∈ called state - {x}. (σ state) (Inl x) = (σ state') (Inl x)"
    and "repeat_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = repeat x state
    ⟹ ∀x ∈ called state. (σ state) (Inl x) = (σ state') (Inl x)"
    and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
    ⟹ ∀x ∈ called state. (σ state) (Inl x) = (σ state') (Inl x)"
proof(induction x y state and x state and x state and y t state
    arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
    rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query x y state)
  show ?case using Query(1,3)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    note IH = Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(5,2)]
    then show ?thesis using Iterate(3) c_same(2)[OF Iterate(1,2), simplified] Iterate(5) by auto
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  show ?case using Iterate(1,4)
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis using Iterate(4) by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(4,2)]
    then show ?thesis
      using Iterate(4) Fixpoint(5) by (simp add: image_Int Diff_eq flip: restrict_restrict)
  next
    case (Continue state1 xd_new infl2 stabl2)
    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(7,2)]
    have c_same: "called state1 = called state" using c_same(3)[OF Continue(1,2)] by simp
    note ih = Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(7,2) _ Continue(3,4) _ Continue(6), simplified]
    then show ?thesis
      using Iterate(4) IH by (simp add: c_same fun_upd_other)
  qed
next
  case (Repeat x state)
  show ?case using Repeat(1,4)
  proof (cases rule: repeat_unstable_stable_cases)
    case (Unstable state1 d1)
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Unstable(2)]
    have c_same: "called state1 = called state" using c_same(4)[OF Unstable(1,2)] by simp
    note ih = Repeat.IH(3)[OF Unstable(2) _ Unstable(3,5), of d1, simplified]
    then show ?thesis using IH by (simp add: c_same)
  next
    case Stable
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Stable(2)]
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval(1,7)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (QueryL y g yd state1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(2)[OF QueryL(1,2,4)]
    have c_same: "called state1 = called state" using c_same(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] by simp
    note ih = Eval.IH(3)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) _ QueryL(6), simplified]
    then show ?thesis using IH by (simp add: c_same)
  next
    case (QueryG y g yd)
    note IH = Eval.IH(4)[OF QueryG(1-3,5)]
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case (Side_Subsumed y yd d' t1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(5)[OF Side_Subsumed(1-4,6)]
    then show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case (Side_Effect y yd d' t1 infl1 stabl1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(6)[OF Side_Effect(1-5) _ Side_Effect(7), simplified]
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: c_same fun_upd_other)
  qed fast+
qed

lemma increasing_values_for_globals:
  shows "query_dom x y state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = query x y state
    ⟹ ∀u. (σ state) (Inr u) ≤ (σ state') (Inr u)"
    and "iterate_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state
    ⟹ ∀u. (σ state) (Inr u) ≤ (σ state') (Inr u)"
    and "repeat_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = repeat x state
    ⟹ ∀u. (σ state) (Inr u) ≤ (σ state') (Inr u)"
    and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
    ⟹ ∀u. (σ state) (Inr u) ≤ (σ state') (Inr u)"
proof(induction x y state and x state and x state and y t state
    arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
    rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query x y state)
  show ?case using Query(1,3)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    note IH = Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(5,2)]
    then show ?thesis using Iterate(3) by simp
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  show ?case using Iterate(1,4)
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis using Iterate(4) by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(4,2)]
    then show ?thesis using Fixpoint(5) by simp
  next
    case (Continue state1 xd_new infl2 stabl2)
    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(7,2)]
    note ih = Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(7,2) _ Continue(3,4) _ Continue(6), simplified]
    have "((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) (Inr u) = (σ state1) (Inr u)" for u
      by (simp add: fun_upd_other)
    then show ?thesis using IH ih order.trans by fastforce
  qed
next
  case (Repeat x state)
  show ?case using Repeat(1,4)
  proof (cases rule: repeat_unstable_stable_cases)
    case (Unstable state1 d1)
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Unstable(2)]
    note ih = Repeat.IH(3)[OF Unstable(2) _ Unstable(3,5), of d1, simplified]
    then show ?thesis using IH order.trans by fastforce
  next
    case Stable
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Stable(2)]
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval(1,7)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (QueryL y g yd state1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(2)[OF QueryL(1,2,4)]
    note ih = Eval.IH(3)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) _ QueryL(6), simplified]
    then show ?thesis using IH order.trans by fastforce
  next
    case (QueryG y g yd)
    note IH = Eval.IH(4)[OF QueryG(1-3,5)]
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case (Side_Subsumed y yd d' t1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(5)[OF Side_Subsumed(1-4,6)]
    then show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case (Side_Effect y yd d' t1 infl1 stabl1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(6)[OF Side_Effect(1-5) _ Side_Effect(7), simplified]
    have "(σ state) (Inr u) ≤ ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) (Inr u)" for u
      apply (cases "u = y")
      subgoal using Side_Effect(3) by (simp add: fun_upd_same)
      subgoal by (simp add: fun_upd_other)
      done
    then show ?thesis using IH order.trans by fastforce
  qed fast+
qed

lemma called_non_stabl_increasing:
  shows "query_dom x y state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = query x y state
    ⟹ called state - stabl state ⊆ called state' - stabl state'"
    and "iterate_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state
    ⟹ (called state - {x}) - stabl state ⊆ (called state' - {x}) - stabl state'"
    and "repeat_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = repeat x state
    ⟹ (called state - {x}) - stabl state ⊆ (called state' - {x}) - stabl state'"
    and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
    ⟹ called state - stabl state ⊆ called state' - stabl state'"
proof(induction x y state and x state and x state and y t state
    arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
    rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query x y state)
  show ?case using Query(1,3)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    note IH = Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(5,2)]
    then show ?thesis using Iterate(3) c_same(2)[OF Iterate(1,2), simplified] Iterate(5) by auto
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  show ?case using Iterate(1,4)
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis using Iterate(4) by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(4,2)]
    then show ?thesis using Iterate(4) Fixpoint(5) by simp
  next
    case (Continue state1 xd_new infl2 stabl2)
    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(7,2)]
    note ih = Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(7,2) _ Continue(3,4) _ Continue(6), simplified]
    then show ?thesis using IH destab_removes[OF Continue(4)] by blast
  qed
next
  case (Repeat x state)
  show ?case using Repeat(1,4)
  proof (cases rule: repeat_unstable_stable_cases)
    case (Unstable state1 d1)
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Unstable(2)]
    note ih = Repeat.IH(3)[OF Unstable(2) _ Unstable(3,5), of d1, simplified]
    then show ?thesis using IH by auto
  next
    case Stable
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Stable(2)]
    then show ?thesis using Stable(3) by auto
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval(1,7)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (QueryL y g yd state1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(2)[OF QueryL(1,2,4)]
    note ih = Eval.IH(3)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) _ QueryL(6), simplified]
    then show ?thesis using IH by auto
  next
    case (QueryG y g yd)
    note IH = Eval.IH(4)[OF QueryG(1-3,5)]
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case (Side_Subsumed y yd d' t1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(5)[OF Side_Subsumed(1-4,6)]
    then show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case (Side_Effect y yd d' t1 infl1 stabl1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(6)[OF Side_Effect(1-5) _ Side_Effect(7), simplified]
    then show ?thesis using destab_removes[OF Side_Effect(5)] by blast
  qed fast+
qed


subsection ‹Predicate for Well-formed Stable Set and Infl Map›

definition well_infl_stabl where
  "well_infl_stabl state ≡
    (∀y∈(stabl state) - (called state). ∀x ∈ dep T (σ state) y. y ∈ slookup (infl state) x)
    ∧ {u. slookup (infl state) (Inl u) ≠ {}} ⊆ stabl state ∪ called state"

abbreviation "update_rel state state' ≡
  let no_indirect_side = {u. ∃x ∈ called state ∩ stabl state'. x ∈ slookup (infl state) u} in
  (∀u ∈ no_indirect_side. slookup (infl state) u ⊆ slookup (infl state') u)
  ∧ {u. Inl u ∈ no_indirect_side} ∩ stabl state ⊆ stabl state'
  ∧ (∀u ∈ no_indirect_side. (σ state) u = (σ state') u)"
(* A sufficient weaker version for property (2) for TD_unopt is:
   {u. Inl u ∈ no_indirect_side} ∩ stabl state ⊆ stabl state' ∪ called state'
   This corresponds to the predicate used for TD_opt.
*)

abbreviation "update_rel_opt state state' ≡
  let no_indirect_side = {u. ∃x ∈ called state ∩ stabl state'. x ∈ slookup (infl state) u} in
  (∀u ∈ no_indirect_side. slookup (infl state) u ⊆ slookup (infl state') u)
  ∧ {u. Inl u ∈ no_indirect_side} ∩ stabl state ⊆ stabl state' ∪ called state'
  ∧ (∀u ∈ no_indirect_side. (σ state) u = (σ state') u)"
(* Property (2) needs to be relaxed for TD_opt compared to update_rel.
   The predicate update_rel as is does not hold for TD_opt.
   This weaker version also holds for TD_unopt and is sufficient to prove it correct *)

lemma well_infl_stabl_implies_stabl_c_closed:
  assumes "well_infl_stabl state"
  shows "∀y∈(stabl state) - (called state). dep⇩L T (σ state) y ⊆ stabl state ∪ called state"
proof (intro ballI subsetI, goal_cases)
  case (1 y x)
  then have "y ∈ slookup (infl state) (Inl x)"
    using assms(1) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def dep⇩L_def by blast
  then have "slookup (infl state) (Inl x) ≠ {}" by auto
  then show ?case using assms(1) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def by blast
qed

lemma well_infl_stabl_simp_c_stabl:
  assumes "x ∈ called state"
    and "well_infl_stabl state"
  shows "well_infl_stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
proof -
  have "stabl state ∪ (called state - {x}) ⊆ insert x (stabl state ∪ called state)" by auto
  moreover have "insert x (stabl state) - called state ⊆ stabl state - (called state - {x})"
    using assms(1) by auto
  ultimately show ?thesis
    using assms(2)
    unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
    by fastforce
qed

lemma well_infl_stabl_simp_add_to_c:
  assumes "well_infl_stabl (state⦇ called := (called state) - {x} ⦈)"
  shows "well_infl_stabl state"
  using assms
  unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
  by auto

end ―‹end of locale TD_side defining the solver›


subsection ‹Correctness of Unoptimized TDside with Full Destabilization›

locale TD_side_unopt =
  fixes abort :: "bool"
    and T :: "('x,'g,'d::bounded_semilattice_sup_bot) eqsT"
begin

sublocale TD_side "λx i s called. destab x i s"
  unfolding TD_side_def
  using destab_infl_stabl_relation
  by blast

subsubsection ‹Well-formedness of Stable Set and Infl Map›

paragraph ‹Preservation of the Well-formedness of Stabl and Infl when Destabilizing›

lemma destab_x_no_dep:
  assumes "stabl2 = (stabl state1) - influenced_by (infl state1) (Inl x)"
    and "∀y∈(stabl state1) - (called state1 - {x}). ∀z∈dep T (σ state1) y. y ∈ slookup (infl state1) z"
  shows "∀y ∈ stabl2 - (called state1 - {x}). Inl x ∉ dep T (σ state1) y"
proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
  case (1 y)
  show ?case
  proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
    case 1
    then have "y ∈ slookup (infl state1) (Inl x)"
      using assms ‹y ∈ stabl2 - (called state1 - {x})› by blast
    then have "y ∈ influenced_by (infl state1) (Inl x)"
      using lookup_in_influenced by force
    moreover have "y ∉ influenced_by (infl state1) (Inl x)"
      using assms(1) ‹y ∈ stabl2 - (called state1 - {x})› by fastforce
    ultimately show ?case by auto
  qed
qed

lemma destab_and_upd_preserves_dep_closed_in_infl:
  assumes "(infl2, stabl2) = destab (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
    and "(∀y∈stabl state1 - (called state1 - {x}). ∀z∈dep T (σ state1) y. y ∈ slookup (infl state1) z)"
  shows "(∀y∈stabl2 - (called state1 - {x}). ∀z∈dep T ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd')) y.
            y ∈ slookup infl2 z)"
proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
  case (1 z y)
  have infl2_def:
      "infl2 = fmdrop_set (Inl ` insert x (influenced_by (infl state1) (Inl x))) (infl state1)"
    and stabl2_def: "stabl2 = (stabl state1) - influenced_by (infl state1) (Inl x)"
    using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF assms(1)]
    by simp+

  have "y ∈ dep T (σ state1) z"
  proof (goal_cases)
    case 1
    have "∀y∈stabl2 - (called state1 - {x}). Inl x ∉ dep T (σ state1) y"
      using assms(2) stabl2_def destab_x_no_dep by blast
    then have "Inl x ∉ dep T (σ state1) z"
        using ‹z ∈ stabl2 - (called state1 - {x})› by blast
      then have "dep T ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd')) z = dep T (σ state1) z"
        apply (intro dep_eq[of T "σ state1", symmetric])
        apply (intro ballI)
        subgoal for y
          apply (cases "y = Inl x")
          by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same fun_upd_other)
        done
    then show ?case using ‹y ∈ dep T ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd')) z› by auto
  qed
  then have z_in_infl1_y: "z ∈ slookup (infl state1) y"
    using 1(1) stabl2_def assms(2) by fastforce

  have "z ∈ influenced_by (infl state1) y"
    using lookup_in_influenced[of "infl state1" y] z_in_infl1_y
    by auto
  then have "y ∉ Inl ` influenced_by (infl state1) (Inl x)" and "y ≠ Inl x"
    using stabl2_def 1(1) influenced_by_transitive by fast+
  then show ?case
    using z_in_infl1_y fmlookup_drop_set infl2_def
    unfolding fmlookup_default_def
    by fastforce
qed

text‹The following lemmas show that the well-formedness of infl and stabl are preserved when
  destabilizing and unknown and updating its value in @{term σ}.›

lemma destab_upd_locale_preserves_well_infl_stabl:
  assumes "(infl2, stabl2) = destab (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
      and "well_infl_stabl (state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
    shows "well_infl_stabl (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
            σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := d_new), called := called state1 - {x} ⦈)"
proof -
  show ?thesis
    using assms(2)
    unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
  proof (intro conjI subsetI, goal_cases)
    case 1
    then show ?case
      using destab_and_upd_preserves_dep_closed_in_infl[OF assms(1)]
      by simp

    case (2 u)
    then show ?case
      apply simp
      by (auto simp add: destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF assms(1)] fmlookup_default_drop_set
        simp flip: fmdrop_set_insert split: if_splits)
  qed
qed

lemma destab_upd_globale_preserves_well_infl_stabl:
  assumes destab: "(infl1, stabl1) = destab (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state)"
      and "well_infl_stabl state"
    shows "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1,
            σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d') ⦈)"
  using assms(2) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
  apply (simp add: destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab])
  apply (intro conjI)
  subgoal
  proof (intro ballI, goal_cases 2)
    case (2 u v)
    have "v ∈ dep T (σ state) u"
    proof -
      have "u ∉ influenced_by (infl state) (Inr y)" using 2(2) by simp
      then have "Inr y ∉ dep T (σ state) u" using 2(1,2) lookup_in_influenced by fastforce
      then show ?thesis
        using 2(3)
        apply (subst dep_eq[of _ _ _ "(σ state)(Inr y := d')"])
        by (metis fun_upd_other)
    qed
    then have "u ∈ slookup (infl state) v" using 2(1,2) by blast
    then show ?case
      using 2(2) influenced_by_transitive[of _ _ "Inr y" u]
        lookup_in_influenced[of "infl state" v] ‹u ∈ slookup (infl state) v›
      by (auto simp add: fmlookup_default_drop_set simp flip: fmdrop_set_insert)
  qed
  subgoal
  proof -
    have "{u. slookup (infl state) (Inl u) ≠ {}} ⊆ stabl state ∪ called state"
      using assms(2) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def by simp
    then show ?thesis
    by (auto simp add: destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF assms(1)] fmlookup_default_drop_set
        simp flip: fmdrop_set_insert)
  qed
  done


paragraph ‹Helper Lemmas to Deduced Update Predicate›

lemma influencing_stabl_after_destab':
  assumes "(infl2, stabl2) = destab y infl1 stabl1"
    "z ∈ slookup infl1 u" "z ∈ stabl2"
  shows "z ∈ slookup infl2 u"
proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
  case 1
  then have "z ∉ slookup (fmdrop_set (insert y (Inl ` influenced_by infl1 y)) infl1) u"
    using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF assms(1)] by blast
  then consider "u = y" | "u ∈ Inl ` influenced_by infl1 y"
    using assms(2)
    unfolding fmlookup_default_def
    by (auto split: if_splits)
  then have "z ∈ influenced_by infl1 y"
    using assms(2)
    apply cases
    subgoal using lookup_in_influenced by fast
    subgoal using lookup_in_influenced influenced_by_transitive[of _ infl1 y z] by fast
    done
  then have "z ∉ stabl2" using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF assms(1)] by blast
  then show ?case using assms(3) by simp
qed

lemma update_rel_transitive:
  assumes update_rel: "update_rel state1 state2" "update_rel state2 state3"
    and indicator_u_dec: "called state3 ∩ stabl state3 ⊆ called state2 ∩ stabl state2"
    and called_same: "called state1 = called state2" "called state2 = called state3"
  shows "update_rel state1 state3"
proof -
  let ?no_indirect_side1 = "{u. ∃x∈called state1 ∩ stabl state2. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) u}"
  let ?no_indirect_side2 = "{u. ∃x∈called state2 ∩ stabl state3. x ∈ slookup (infl state2) u}"
  let ?no_indirect_side3 = "{u. ∃x∈called state1 ∩ stabl state3. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) u}"
  have unaffected_subset: "?no_indirect_side3 ⊆ ?no_indirect_side1"
      "?no_indirect_side3 ⊆ ?no_indirect_side2"
    using update_rel(1) indicator_u_dec called_same
    by fastforce+

  show ?thesis
    apply simp
    apply (intro conjI)
    subgoal
      using unaffected_subset conjunct1[OF update_rel(1)[simplified]]
        conjunct1[OF update_rel(2)[simplified]]
      by blast
    subgoal
      using unaffected_subset conjunct1[OF conjunct2[OF update_rel(1)[simplified]]]
        conjunct1[OF conjunct2[OF update_rel(2)[simplified]]]
      by blast
    subgoal
      using unaffected_subset conjunct2[OF conjunct2[OF update_rel(1)[simplified]]]
        conjunct2[OF conjunct2[OF update_rel(2)[simplified]]]
      by fastforce
    done
qed


paragraph ‹Induction Proof›

lemma well_infl_stabl_ind:
  shows "query_dom x y state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = query x y state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state'
      ∧ x ∈ slookup (infl state') (Inl y)
      ∧ update_rel state state'"
    and "iterate_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl (state'⦇called := called state' - {x}⦈)
      ∧ x ∈ stabl state'
      ∧ update_rel (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (state'⦇called := called state' - {x}⦈)"
    and "repeat_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = repeat x state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl (state'⦇called := called state' - {x}⦈)
      ∧ x ∈ stabl state'
      ∧ update_rel (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (state'⦇called := called state' - {x}⦈)"
    and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ x ∈ stabl state ⟶ (subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state) = Some t
        ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set pre}. x ∈ slookup (infl state) p))
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state'
      ∧ (x ∈ stabl state' ⟶ (∀y∈dep_aux (σ state') t. x ∈ slookup (infl state') y))
      ∧ update_rel state state'"
proof(induction x y state and x state and x state and y t state
    arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state' and pre xd state'
    rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    note IH = Query.IH(2)[simplified, OF Iterate(5,2) Query.prems(2)]
    then show ?thesis
      using Iterate(3,4) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
      by (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert split: if_splits)
  next
    case Lookup
    show ?thesis
      using Query.prems(2) Lookup(3)
      unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
      by (auto simp add: Lookup(2) slookup_fminsert)
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  have inv: "well_infl_stabl state"
    using well_infl_stabl_simp_add_to_c[OF Iterate.prems(3)] by simp
  note IH' = Iterate.IH(2)[rotated 2, OF Iterate.prems(2) inv]

  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    show ?thesis using Stable(2,3) Iterate.prems(3) by (simp add: Stable(1))
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    note IH = IH'[OF Fixpoint(4,2), folded dep_def]
    then show ?thesis
      unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
      by (auto simp add: Fixpoint(5))
  next
    case (Continue state1 xd_new infl2 stabl2)
    note IH = IH'[OF Continue(7,2)]

    have c_state1_same_state: "called state1 = called state"
      using c_same(3)[OF Continue(1,2)] by simp
    then have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1"
      using Iterate.prems(2) by simp

    have inv: "well_infl_stabl (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
        σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
      apply (rule destab_upd_locale_preserves_well_infl_stabl[OF Continue(4)])
      using IH
      by auto

    note ih = Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(7,2) _ Continue(3,4) _ Continue(6), simplified,
              OF x_in_c1 inv]

    have "called state' = called state1 - {x}" using c_same(2)[OF Continue(5,6)] x_in_c1 by simp

    with IH show ?thesis
    proof(elim conjE, intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      show ?case using ih by blast
    next
      case 2
      show ?case using ih by blast
    next
      case 3
      have upd_rel_destab:
        "update_rel (state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈) (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
          σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
        using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(4)]
          influencing_stabl_after_destab'[OF Continue(4)]
        by (auto simp add: fmlookup_default_drop_set fun_upd_other simp del: fmdrop_set_insert
            split: if_split)
      have upd_rel_begin_destab:
        "update_rel (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
          σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
        apply (intro update_rel_transitive[OF 3(4) upd_rel_destab])
        using called_non_stabl_increasing(3)[OF Continue(1,2)] ‹called state1 = called state›
          destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(4)]
        by auto
      show ?case
        apply (intro update_rel_transitive[OF upd_rel_begin_destab])
        using ih called_non_stabl_increasing(2)[OF Continue(5,6)] ‹called state' = called state1 - {x}›
          c_state1_same_state
        by auto
    qed
  qed
next
  case (Repeat x state)
  have inv: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using Repeat.prems(2,3) by (simp add: well_infl_stabl_simp_c_stabl)
  have prefix: "x ∈ stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) ⟶ (
      subt_for_prefix (T x) [] (σ (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)) = Some (T x)
      ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set []}. x ∈ slookup (infl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)) p))"
    by simp+

  show ?case using Repeat.IH(1) Repeat.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: repeat_unstable_stable_cases)
    case (Unstable state1 d1)
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Unstable(2) inv _ prefix, simplified, OF Repeat.prems(2)]

    have "called state1 = called state"
      using c_same(4)[OF Unstable(1,2)] by simp
    then have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1"
      using Repeat.prems(2) by simp
    have inv1: "well_infl_stabl state1"
      using IH by simp

    note ih = Repeat.IH(3)[OF Unstable(2) _ Unstable(3,5) x_in_c1 inv1, of d1, simplified]

    have "called state' = called state1" using c_same(3)[OF Unstable(4,5)] by simp

    show ?thesis
      apply (intro conjI)
      subgoal using ih by simp
      subgoal using ih by simp
      subgoal
        apply (rule update_rel_transitive[of _ "state1⦇called := called state1 - {x} ⦈"])
        subgoal using IH Unstable(3) by auto
        subgoal using ih Unstable(3) by simp
        subgoal using called_non_stabl_increasing(3)[OF Unstable(4,5)] ‹called state' = called state1› by auto
        subgoal using ‹called state1 = called state› by simp
        subgoal using ‹called state' = called state1› by simp
        done
      done
  next
    case Stable
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Stable(2) inv _ prefix, simplified, OF Repeat.prems(2)]
    show ?thesis
      unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
      apply (intro conjI)
      subgoal
        apply (rule ballI)
        using IH Stable(3)
        unfolding well_infl_stabl_def dep_def
        by auto
      subgoal using IH Stable(3) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def by auto
      subgoal
        using Stable(3) by blast
      subgoal
        apply simp
        using Stable(3) IH by blast
      done
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (QueryL y g yd state1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(2)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) Eval.prems(2)]

    have "called state1 = called state" using c_same(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] by simp
    then have "x ∈ called state1" using Eval.prems(3) by simp
    have "called state' = called state1" using c_same(4)[OF QueryL(5,6)] by simp

    have prefix_no_indirect_side: "{p. Inl p ∈ set pre}
        ⊆ {u. ∃x ∈ called state ∩ stabl state1. x ∈ slookup (infl state) u}"
        if "x ∈ stabl state1"
      using that called_non_stabl_increasing(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] ‹x ∈ called state1› Eval.prems(3,4) IH
      by fastforce

    have prefix: "x ∈ stabl state1 ⟶
      (subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inl (Inl y)]) (σ state1) = Some (g yd)
      ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inl y)])}. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) p))"
    proof (intro impI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "x ∈ stabl state"
        using called_non_stabl_increasing(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] Eval.prems(3) by blast
      show ?case using Eval.prems(4)[rule_format, OF ‹x ∈ stabl state›]
      proof (intro conjI impI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case
          apply (intro subt_for_prefix_transitive[where ?t2.0=t])
          subgoal
            apply (subst subt_for_prefix_same[where ?sigma'="(σ state)"])
            subgoal using prefix_no_indirect_side ‹x ∈ stabl state1› IH by fastforce
            subgoal by simp
            done
          subgoal using QueryL(2,7) by simp
          done
      next
        case 2
        then show ?case
          using conjunct2[OF IH] prefix_no_indirect_side[OF 1] by fastforce
      qed
    qed

    note ih = Eval.IH(3)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) _ QueryL(6) conjunct1[OF IH] ‹x ∈ called state1› prefix,
        simplified]

    have y_unaffected:
      "Inl y ∈ {u. ∃x ∈ called state1 ∩ stabl state'. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) u}"
        if "x ∈ stabl state'"
      using lookup_in_influenced that called_non_stabl_increasing(4)[OF QueryL(5,6)]
        prefix c_same(4)[OF QueryL(5,6)] ‹x ∈ called state1›
      by fastforce
    have y_value_unchanged: "(σ state') (Inl y) = yd" if "x ∈ stabl state'"
      using y_unaffected[OF that] ih QueryL(7) by fastforce
    have y_infl_incr: "slookup (infl state1) (Inl y) ⊆ slookup (infl state') (Inl y)"
      if "x ∈ stabl state'"
      using y_unaffected[OF that] ih by auto

    show ?thesis
      apply (intro conjI)
      subgoal using ih by simp
      subgoal using ih IH y_infl_incr by (auto simp add: QueryL(2) y_value_unchanged)
      subgoal
        apply (rule update_rel_transitive[of _ state1])
        using IH ih called_non_stabl_increasing(4)[OF QueryL(5,6)] ‹called state' = called state1›
          ‹called state1 = called state›
        by auto
      done
  next
    case (QueryG y g yd)
    have inv: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
      using Eval.prems(2) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def by auto
    have prefix: "x ∈ stabl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈) ⟶ (
        subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inl (Inr y)])
        (σ (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)) = Some (g yd)
      ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inr y)])}. x ∈ slookup
        (infl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)) p))"
      using Eval.prems(4) QueryG(2,3) subt_for_prefix_transitive[of "T x" pre _ t "[Inl (Inr y)]"]
      by (simp add: fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)
    note IH = Eval.IH(4)[OF QueryG(1-3,5) inv _ prefix, simplified, OF Eval.prems(3)]

    have y_unaffected: "Inr y ∈ {u. ∃z ∈ called state ∩ stabl state'.
        z ∈ slookup (fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x) u}"
        if "x ∈ stabl state'"
      using lookup_in_influenced that called_non_stabl_increasing(4)[OF QueryG(4,5)]
        c_same(4)[OF QueryG(4,5)] ‹x ∈ called state›
      by (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert_same)
    have y_value_unchanged: "(σ state') (Inr y) = yd" if "x ∈ stabl state'"
      using y_unaffected IH QueryG(3) that by fastforce
    have y_infl_incr: "slookup (infl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)) (Inr y)
        ⊆ slookup (infl state') (Inr y)" if "x ∈ stabl state'"
      using y_unaffected IH that by fastforce

    show ?thesis
      apply (intro conjI)
      subgoal using IH by simp
      subgoal
        using IH y_infl_incr by (auto simp add: QueryG(2) y_value_unchanged slookup_fminsert_same)
      subgoal using IH by (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert split: if_splits)
      done
  next
    case (Side_Subsumed y yd d' t1)
    have prefix: "x ∈ stabl state ⟶
      (subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) (σ state) = Some t1
      ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)])}. x ∈ slookup (infl state) p))"
      using Eval.prems(4) subt_for_prefix_transitive[of "T x" pre _ t "[Inr (y, yd)]" t1]
        Side_Subsumed(2)
      by simp
    note IH = Eval.IH(5)[OF Side_Subsumed(1-4,6) Eval.prems(2,3) prefix]

    have "x ∈ stabl state' ⟶ (∀y∈dep_aux (σ state') t. x ∈ slookup (infl state') y)"
      using IH
      by (simp add: Side_Subsumed(2) dep_aux⇩L_def)

    then show ?thesis using IH by simp
  next
    case (Side_Effect y yd d' t1 infl1 stabl1)
    have inv:
        "well_infl_stabl (state ⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
      using destab_upd_globale_preserves_well_infl_stabl[OF Side_Effect(5) Eval.prems(2)]
      by simp
    have x_stabl_if_stabl1: "x ∈ stabl state" if "x ∈ stabl1"
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Side_Effect(5)] that by simp

    have prefix_recorded_in_infl:
      "∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set pre}. x ∈ slookup (infl state) p" if "x ∈ stabl state"
      using Eval.prems(4) that by simp

    have y_not_in_prefix: "Inl (Inr y) ∉ set pre" if "x ∈ stabl1"
    proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "x ∈ slookup (infl state) (Inr y)"
        using prefix_recorded_in_infl that x_stabl_if_stabl1 by simp
      then have "x ∈ influenced_by (infl state) (Inr y)"
        using lookup_in_influenced by fastforce
      then show ?case using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Side_Effect(5)] that by simp
    qed

    have prefix: "x ∈ stabl (state ⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)
      ⟶ (subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) (σ (state
        ⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)) = Some t1
      ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)])}. x ∈ slookup
        (infl (state ⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)) p))"
      apply simp
    proof
      assume A: "x ∈ stabl1"
      have P: "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) = Some t"
        apply (subst subt_for_prefix_same[where ?sigma'="(σ state)"])
        subgoal using y_not_in_prefix A by (simp add: fun_upd_apply)
        subgoal using Eval.prems(4) x_stabl_if_stabl1 A by simp
        done
      show "subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) = Some t1 ∧
        (∀p. Inl p ∈ set pre ⟶ x ∈ slookup infl1 p)"
        apply (intro conjI)
        apply (subst subt_for_prefix_transitive[OF P(1), of "[Inr (y, yd)]" t1])
        subgoal using Side_Effect(2) by simp
        subgoal by simp
        subgoal using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Side_Effect(5)]
          by (smt (z3) A Diff_iff influenced_by_transitive
              lookup_in_influenced fmlookup_default_drop_set
              image_iff insert_iff mem_Collect_eq prefix_recorded_in_infl
              subset_iff)
        done
    qed

    note IH = Eval.IH(6)[OF Side_Effect(1-5) _ Side_Effect(7) inv _ prefix, simplified,
        OF Eval.prems(3)]

    have upd_rel_destab:
      "update_rel state (state⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1,
        σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Side_Effect(5)] Side_Effect(5)
        influencing_stabl_after_destab'[OF Side_Effect(5)]
      by (auto simp add: fmlookup_default_drop_set fun_upd_other simp del: fmdrop_set_insert
          split: if_split)

    have "called state' = called state"
      using c_same(4)[OF Side_Effect(6,7)] by simp

    have "x ∈ stabl state' ⟶ (∀y∈dep_aux (σ state') t. x ∈ slookup (infl state') y)"
      using IH by (simp add: Side_Effect(2) dep_aux⇩L_def)

    then show ?thesis
      apply (intro conjI)
      subgoal using IH by simp
      subgoal using IH by simp
      subgoal
        apply (rule update_rel_transitive[OF upd_rel_destab])
        subgoal using IH by auto
        subgoal
          using called_non_stabl_increasing(4)[OF Side_Effect(6,7)] ‹called state' = called state› by auto
        subgoal by simp
        subgoal using ‹called state' = called state› by simp
        done
      done
  next
    case Answer
    have "∀y∈dep_aux (σ state') t. x ∈ slookup (infl state') y"
      by (simp add: Answer(2) dep_aux_def)
    moreover have "dep_aux⇩L (σ state) t ⊆ stabl state ∪ called state"
      by (simp add: Answer(2) dep_aux⇩L_def)
    ultimately show ?thesis using Eval.prems(2) Answer(3) by simp
  next
    case Abort
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(2) by fastforce
  qed
qed

corollary solve_returns_stabl_closed_under_dep:
  assumes "solve_dom x"
    and "solve x = (st, sigma)"
  shows "∀x∈st. dep⇩L T sigma x ⊆ st"
proof -
  obtain xd state' where
      iterate: "(xd, state') = iterate x (init_state⦇ called := insert x (called init_state) ⦈)"
      and "st = stabl state'" and "sigma = σ state'"
    using assms unfolding solve_dom_def solve_def
    by (cases "iterate x (init_state⦇called := insert x (called init_state)⦈)") auto
  then have "well_infl_stabl (state'⦇called := called state' - {x}⦈)"
    using well_infl_stabl_ind(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def]]
    unfolding well_infl_stabl_def init_state_def fmlookup_default_def
    by auto
  show ?thesis
    using well_infl_stabl_implies_stabl_c_closed[OF ‹well_infl_stabl (state'⦇called := called state' - {x}⦈)›]
      ‹st = stabl state'› ‹sigma = σ state'› c_same(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] iterate]
    unfolding well_infl_stabl_def init_state_def
    by simp
qed

subsubsection ‹Partial Correctness›

paragraph ‹Preservation of the Partial Solution when Destabilizing›

lemma destab_upd_locale_preserves_part_solution:
  assumes destab: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
      and IH: "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state1) (stabl state1 - called state1)"
          "eq T x (σ state1) = xd_new"
          "sides_of_rhs (T x) (σ state1) ≤ σ state1"
      and x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1"
      and well_infl_stabl_1: "well_infl_stabl (state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
    shows "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) (stabl2 - (called state1 - {x}))"
proof -
  have "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state1) (stabl state1 - called state1)"
    using IH by simp
  have "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) (stabl2 - called state1)"
  proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
    case (1 y)
    then have "y ∈ stabl state1 - called state1" "x ≠ y"
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab] x_in_c1 by auto
    then have "eq T y (σ state1) = (σ state1) (Inl y)"
      "sides_of_rhs (T y) (σ state1) ≤ σ state1"
      using IH by simp+
    have "Inl x ∉ dep T (σ state1) y"
    proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "Inl x ∈ dep T (σ state1) y" by simp
      then have "y ∈ slookup (infl state1) (Inl x)"
        using well_infl_stabl_1 ‹y ∈ stabl state1 - called state1›
        unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
        by simp
      then have "y ∈ influenced_by (infl state1) (Inl x)"
        using lookup_in_influenced by fast
      then have "y ∉ stabl2" using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab] by simp
      then show ?case using ‹y ∈ stabl2 - called state1› by simp
    qed
    then have "eq T y (σ state1) = eq T y ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new))"
      using eq_mupd_no_dep
      unfolding dep_def by fast
    moreover have "(σ state1) (Inl y) = ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) (Inl y)"
      using ‹x ≠ y› by (simp add: fun_upd_other)
    moreover have "sides_of_rhs (T y) ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) ≤ (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)"
      apply (rule subsumes_se_eq[of "σ state1"])
      subgoal
      proof -
        have "Inl x ∉ dep_aux (σ state1) (T y)"
          using ‹Inl x ∉ dep T (σ state1) y› unfolding dep_aux_def dep_def by simp
        then show ?thesis by (metis fun_upd_other)
      qed
      subgoal
        by (simp add: fun_upd_other)
      subgoal
        using IH ‹y ∈ stabl state1 - called state1› by blast
      done
    ultimately show ?case
      using ‹eq T y (σ state1) = (σ state1) (Inl y)› by simp
  qed
  moreover have "eq T x ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) = xd_new"
    "sides_of_rhs (T x) ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) ≤ (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)"
    if "x ∈ stabl2"
  proof -
    have "x ∈ stabl state1"
      using that destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab] by simp
    have "x ∉ influenced_by (infl state1) (Inl x)"
      using that destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab] by simp
    then have "x ∉ slookup (infl state1) (Inl x)"
      using lookup_in_influenced by fast
    then have "Inl x ∉ dep T (σ state1) x"
      using conjunct1[OF well_infl_stabl_1[unfolded well_infl_stabl_def]]
        ‹x ∈ stabl state1›
      by auto
    then show "eq T x ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) = xd_new"
      using eq_mupd_no_dep IH by fastforce
    show "sides_of_rhs (T x) ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) ≤ (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)"
      apply (rule subsumes_se_eq[of "σ state1"])
      subgoal
      proof -
        have "Inl x ∉ dep_aux (σ state1) (T x)"
          using ‹Inl x ∉ dep T (σ state1) x› unfolding dep_aux_def dep_def by simp
        then show ?thesis
          using ‹Inl x ∉ dep T (σ state1) x›
          by (metis fun_upd_other)
      qed
      subgoal
        by (simp add: fun_upd_other)
      subgoal
        using IH by blast
      done
  qed
  ultimately show ?thesis by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same)
qed

lemma destab_upd_globale_preserves_part_solution:
  assumes destab: "(infl1, stabl1) = destab (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state)"
      and part_sol: "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)"
      and well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl state"
      and d_join: "d' = (σ state) (Inr y) ⊔ d"
    shows "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) (stabl1 - called state)"
proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
  case (1 x)
  then have "x ∈ stabl state - called state"
    using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab] by auto
  then have "eq T x (σ state) = (σ state) (Inl x)" "sides_of_rhs (T x) (σ state) ≤ σ state"
    using part_sol by simp+
  have "Inr y ∉ dep T (σ state) x"
  proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
    case 1
    then have "Inr y ∈ dep T (σ state) x" by simp
    then have "x ∈ slookup (infl state) (Inr y)"
      using well_infl_stabl ‹x ∈ stabl state - called state›
      unfolding well_infl_stabl_def by simp
    then have "x ∈ influenced_by (infl state) (Inr y)"
      using lookup_in_influenced by fast
    then have "x ∉ stabl1" using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab] by simp
    then show ?case using ‹x ∈ stabl1 - called state› by simp
  qed
  then have "eq T x (σ state) = eq T x ((σ state)(Inr y := d'))"
    using eq_mupd_no_dep
    unfolding dep_def by fast
  moreover have "(σ state) (Inl x) = ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) (Inl x)"
    by (simp add: fun_upd_other)
  moreover have "sides_of_rhs (T x) ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) ≤ (σ state)(Inr y := d')"
    apply (rule subsumes_se_eq[of "σ state"])
    subgoal
    proof -
      have "Inr y ∉ dep_aux (σ state) (T x)"
        using ‹Inr y ∉ dep T (σ state) x› unfolding dep_aux_def dep_def by simp
      then show ?thesis
        using ‹Inr y ∉ dep T (σ state) x›
        by (metis fun_upd_other)
    qed
    subgoal
    proof
      fix u
      show "(σ state) (Inr u) ≤ ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) (Inr u)"
        apply (cases "u = y")
        subgoal using d_join by (simp add: fun_upd_same)
        subgoal by (simp add: fun_upd_other)
        done
    qed
    subgoal
      using part_sol ‹x ∈ stabl state - called state› by blast
    done
  ultimately show ?case
    using ‹eq T x (σ state) = (σ state) (Inl x)› by simp
qed

paragraph ‹Induction Proof›

lemma eq_equal_sides_subsumed_ind:
  shows "query_dom x y state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = query x y state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state') (stabl state' - called state')"
    and "iterate_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - (called state - {x}))
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state') (stabl state' - (called state' - {x}))"
    and "repeat_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = repeat x state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state') (stabl state' - called state')
        ∧ eq T x (σ state') = xd
        ∧ sides_of_rhs (T x) (σ state') ≤ σ state'"
    and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ x ∈ stabl state ⟶ (subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state) = Some t
        ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set pre}. x ∈ slookup (infl state) p)
        ∧ (∀(u, ud) ∈ {s. Inr s ∈ set pre}. ud ≤ (σ state) (Inr u)))
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state') (stabl state' - called state')
        ∧ (x ∈ stabl state' ⟶ eq T x (σ state') = xd
                                ∧ sides_of_rhs (T x) (σ state') ≤ σ state')"
proof(induction x y state and x state and x state and y t state
    arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state' and pre xd state'
    rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    note IH = Query.IH(2)[simplified, OF Iterate(5,2) Query.prems(2,3)]
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: Iterate(3))
  next
    case Lookup
    show ?thesis using Query.prems(3) by (simp add: Lookup(2))
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  have inv: "well_infl_stabl state"
    using well_infl_stabl_simp_add_to_c[OF Iterate.prems(3)] by simp
  have eq_equal_sides_subsumed: "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)"
    using Iterate.prems(4) by simp
  note IH' = Iterate.IH(2)[rotated 2, OF Iterate.prems(2) inv eq_equal_sides_subsumed]

  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    show ?thesis using Stable(2,3) Iterate.prems(4) by (simp add: Stable(1))
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    note IH = IH'[OF Fixpoint(4,2), folded dep_def]

    then show ?thesis by (auto simp add: Fixpoint(3,5))
  next
    case (Continue state1 xd_new infl2 stabl2)
    note IH = IH'[OF Continue(7,2)]
    note well_infl_stabl_1 = well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) inv]

    have c_state1_same_state: "called state1 = called state" using c_same(3)[OF Continue(1,2)] by simp
    then have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1" using Iterate.prems(2) by simp

    have inv: "well_infl_stabl (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
        σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
      apply (rule destab_upd_locale_preserves_well_infl_stabl[OF Continue(4)])
      using conjunct1[OF well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) inv]]
      unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
      by auto
    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed_2:
        "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) (stabl2 - (called state1 - {x}))"
      apply (rule destab_upd_locale_preserves_part_solution[OF Continue(4)])
      using IH well_infl_stabl_1 x_in_c1 by simp+

    note ih = Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(7,2) _ Continue(3,4) _ Continue(6), simplified,
              OF x_in_c1 inv eq_equal_sides_subsumed_2]

    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
next
  case (Repeat x state)
  have inv: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using Repeat.prems(2,3) by (simp add: well_infl_stabl_simp_c_stabl)
  have eq_equal_sides_subsumed:
      "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))
      (stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) - called (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))"
    using Repeat.prems(2,4) by simp

  show ?case using Repeat.IH(1) Repeat.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: repeat_unstable_stable_cases)
    case (Unstable state1 d1)
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Unstable(2) inv eq_equal_sides_subsumed, of "[]", simplified,
        OF Repeat.prems(2)]

    have "called state1 = called state"
      using c_same(4)[OF Unstable(1,2)] by simp
    then have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1"
      using Repeat.prems(2) by simp
    have inv1: "well_infl_stabl state1"
      using well_infl_stabl_ind(4)[OF Unstable(1,2) inv, of "[]", simplified, OF Repeat.prems(2)]
      by simp

    note ih = Repeat.IH(3)[OF Unstable(2) _ Unstable(3,5) x_in_c1 inv1 conjunct1[OF IH],
        of d1, simplified]

    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case Stable
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Stable(2) inv eq_equal_sides_subsumed, of "[]", simplified,
        OF Repeat.prems(2)]
    then show ?thesis using Stable(3) by simp
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (QueryL y g yd state1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(2)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) Eval.prems(2,3)]
    note well_infl_stabl_1 = well_infl_stabl_ind(1)[OF QueryL(3,4) Eval.prems(2)]

    have prefix_no_indirect_side: "{p. Inl p ∈ set pre}
          ⊆ {u. ∃x ∈ called state ∩ stabl state1. x ∈ slookup (infl state) u}"
        if "x ∈ stabl state1"
      using lookup_in_influenced that called_non_stabl_increasing(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] Eval.prems(4,5)
      by fastforce

    have prefix: "x ∈ stabl state1 ⟶
      (subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inl (Inl y)]) (σ state1) = Some (g yd)
      ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inl y)])}. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) p)
      ∧ (∀(u,ud) ∈ {s. Inr s ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inl y)])}. ud ≤ (σ state1) (Inr u)))"
    proof (intro impI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "x ∈ stabl state"
        using called_non_stabl_increasing(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] Eval.prems(4) by blast
      show ?case using Eval.prems(5)[rule_format, OF ‹x ∈ stabl state›]
      proof (intro conjI impI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case
          apply (intro subt_for_prefix_transitive[where ?t2.0=t])
          subgoal
            apply (subst subt_for_prefix_same[where ?sigma'="(σ state)"])
            subgoal using prefix_no_indirect_side ‹x ∈ stabl state1› well_infl_stabl_1 by fastforce
            subgoal by simp
            done
          subgoal using QueryL(2,7) by simp
          done
      next
        case 2
        then show ?case
          using conjunct2[OF well_infl_stabl_1] prefix_no_indirect_side[OF 1] by fastforce
      next
        case 3
        then show ?case
          using conjunct2[OF well_infl_stabl_1] prefix_no_indirect_side[OF 1]
            increasing_values_for_globals(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)]
          by (auto intro: order.trans[of _ "σ state a" "σ state1 a" for a])
      qed
    qed

    have "called state1 = called state" using c_same(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] by simp
    then have "x ∈ called state1" using Eval.prems(4) by simp
    have "called state' = called state1" using c_same(4)[OF QueryL(5,6)] by simp

    note ih = Eval.IH(3)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) _ QueryL(6) conjunct1[OF well_infl_stabl_1] IH
        ‹x ∈ called state1› prefix, simplified]

    then show ?thesis using ih by simp
  next
    case (QueryG y g yd)
    have inv: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
      using Eval.prems(2) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def
      by simp
    have prefix: "x ∈ stabl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈) ⟶ (
        subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inl (Inr y)])
        (σ (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)) = Some (g yd)
      ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inr y)])}. x ∈ slookup
        (infl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)) p)
      ∧ (∀(u, ud) ∈ {s. Inr s ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inr y)])}.
        ud ≤ (σ (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)) (Inr u)))"
      using Eval.prems(5) QueryG(2,3) subt_for_prefix_transitive[of "T x" pre _ t "[Inl (Inr y)]"]
      by (simp add: fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)

    note IH = Eval.IH(4)[OF QueryG(1-3,5) inv _ _ prefix, simplified, OF Eval.prems(3,4)]

    then show ?thesis using IH by simp
  next
    case (Side_Subsumed y yd d' t1)
    have "yd ≤ (σ state) (Inr y)"
      using Side_Subsumed(3,4) sup_ge2[of yd d'] by simp
    then have prefix: "x ∈ stabl state ⟶
      (subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) (σ state) = Some t1
      ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)])}. x ∈ slookup (infl state) p)
      ∧ (∀(u, ud) ∈ {s. Inr s ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)])}. ud ≤ (σ state) (Inr u)))"
      using Eval.prems(5) subt_for_prefix_transitive[of "T x" pre _ t "[Inr (y, yd)]" t1]
        Side_Subsumed(2)
      by simp

    note IH = Eval.IH(5)[OF Side_Subsumed(1-4,6) Eval.prems(2-4) prefix]

    show ?thesis using IH by simp
  next
    case (Side_Effect y yd d' t1 infl1 stabl1)
    have inv:
        "well_infl_stabl (state ⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
      using destab_upd_globale_preserves_well_infl_stabl[OF Side_Effect(5) Eval.prems(2)] by simp
    have x_stabl_if_stabl1: "x ∈ stabl state" if "x ∈ stabl1"
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Side_Effect(5)] that by simp

    have prefix_recorded_in_infl:
      "∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set pre}. x ∈ slookup (infl state) p" if "x ∈ stabl state"
      using Eval.prems(5) that by simp

    have y_not_in_prefix: "Inl (Inr y) ∉ set pre" if "x ∈ stabl1"
    proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "x ∈ slookup (infl state) (Inr y)"
        using prefix_recorded_in_infl that x_stabl_if_stabl1 by simp
      then have "x ∈ influenced_by (infl state) (Inr y)"
        using lookup_in_influenced by fastforce
      then show ?case using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Side_Effect(5)] that by simp
    qed

    have prefix: "x ∈ stabl1 ⟶
      subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) = Some t1 ∧
      (∀p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) ⟶ x ∈ slookup infl1 p) ∧
      (∀a b. Inr (a, b) ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) ⟶ b ≤ ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) (Inr a))"
    proof (intro impI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "x ∈ stabl state" using x_stabl_if_stabl1 by simp
      show ?case using Eval.prems(5)[rule_format, OF ‹x ∈ stabl state›]
      proof (intro conjI impI allI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case
          apply (intro subt_for_prefix_transitive[where ?t2.0=t])
          subgoal
            apply (subst subt_for_prefix_same[where ?sigma'="(σ state)"])
            by (auto simp add: ‹x ∈ stabl1› fun_upd_def y_not_in_prefix)
          subgoal using Side_Effect(2) by simp
          done
      next
        case (2 p)
        then show ?case using influencing_stabl_after_destab'[OF Side_Effect(5) _ 1] by simp
      next
        case (3 a b)
        then show ?case
          by (auto intro: order.trans[OF _ sup_ge1] simp add: Side_Effect(3) fun_upd_def)
      qed
    qed

    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1:
      "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) (stabl1 - called state)"
      using destab_upd_globale_preserves_part_solution[OF Side_Effect(5) Eval.prems(3,2)
          Side_Effect(3)]
      by simp

    note IH = Eval.IH(6)[OF Side_Effect(1-5) _ Side_Effect(7) inv, simplified,
        OF eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 Eval.prems(4) prefix]

    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case Answer
    have "eq T x (σ state') = xd" if "x ∈ stabl state'"
    proof -
      have "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state) = Some t"
        using Eval.prems(5) Answer(3) that by simp
      then have "eq T x (σ state) = xd"
        using subt_for_prefix_Answer_eq_traverse Answer(2) by blast
      then show ?thesis using Answer(3) by simp
    qed
    moreover have "sides_of_rhs (T x) (σ state') ≤ σ state'" if "x ∈ stabl state'"
    proof -
      have "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state) = Some (Answer xd)"
        using Eval.prems(5) Answer that by simp
      then show ?thesis using subt_for_prefix_Answer_subsumes Eval.prems(5) that Answer(3) by blast
    qed
    ultimately show ?thesis using Eval.prems(3) Answer(3) by simp
  next
    case Abort
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(3) by force
  qed
qed

theorem partial_solution:
  assumes "solve_dom x"
      and "solve x = (st, sigma)"
    shows "part_solution T x sigma st"
proof -
  obtain d state where
    iterate: "(d, state) = iterate x (init_state ⦇ called := insert x (called init_state) ⦈)"
    and st: "st = stabl state" and sigma: "sigma = σ state"
    using assms(2) unfolding solve_def by (auto split: prod.splits)
  have c_empty: "called state = {}"
    using c_same(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] iterate]
    unfolding init_state_def
    by simp
  have well_init: "well_infl_stabl (init_state⦇called := called init_state - {x}⦈)"
    unfolding init_state_def well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def
    by simp
  then have well_result_state: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)"
    and x_stabl: "x ∈ stabl state"
    using well_infl_stabl_ind(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] iterate]
    by auto
  moreover have "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state)"
    using eq_equal_sides_subsumed_ind(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] iterate] c_empty
      well_init
    unfolding init_state_def
    by simp
  moreover have "∀u ∈ stabl state. dep⇩L T (σ state) u ⊆ stabl state"
    using well_infl_stabl_implies_stabl_c_closed[OF well_result_state] c_empty
    unfolding well_infl_stabl_def dep⇩L_def
    by simp
  ultimately show ?thesis using x_stabl st sigma by simp
qed

end ―‹end of context TD_side_unopt›


subsection ‹Least Partial Post-Solution with Monotonicity and Abort for Unoptimized Solver›

locale TD_side_unopt_mono = TD_side_unopt True T for
  T :: "'x ⇒ ('x, 'g, 'd :: bounded_semilattice_sup_bot) strategy_tree" +
