                                ∧ sides_of_rhs (T x) (σ state') ≤ σ state')"
proof(induction x y state and x state and x state and y t state
    arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state' and pre xd state'
    rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    note IH = Query.IH(2)[simplified, OF Iterate(5,2) Query.prems(2,3)]
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: Iterate(3))
  next
    case Lookup
    show ?thesis using Query.prems(3) by (simp add: Lookup(2))
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  have inv: "well_infl_stabl state"
    using well_infl_stabl_simp_add_to_c[OF Iterate.prems(3)] by simp
  have eq_equal_sides_subsumed: "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)"
    using Iterate.prems(4) by simp
  note IH' = Iterate.IH(2)[rotated 2, OF Iterate.prems(2) inv eq_equal_sides_subsumed]

  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    show ?thesis using Stable(2,3) Iterate.prems(4) by (simp add: Stable(1))
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    note IH = IH'[OF Fixpoint(4,2), folded dep_def]

    then show ?thesis by (auto simp add: Fixpoint(3,5))
  next
    case (Continue state1 xd_new infl2 stabl2)
    note IH = IH'[OF Continue(7,2)]
    note well_infl_stabl_1 = well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) inv]

    have c_state1_same_state: "called state1 = called state" using c_same(3)[OF Continue(1,2)] by simp
    then have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1" using Iterate.prems(2) by simp

    have inv: "well_infl_stabl (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
        σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
      apply (rule destab_upd_locale_preserves_well_infl_stabl[OF Continue(4)])
      using conjunct1[OF well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) inv]]
      unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
      by auto
    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed_2:
        "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) (stabl2 - (called state1 - {x}))"
      apply (rule destab_upd_locale_preserves_part_solution[OF Continue(4)])
      using IH well_infl_stabl_1 x_in_c1 by simp+

    note ih = Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(7,2) _ Continue(3,4) _ Continue(6), simplified,
              OF x_in_c1 inv eq_equal_sides_subsumed_2]

    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
next
  case (Repeat x state)
  have inv: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using Repeat.prems(2,3) by (simp add: well_infl_stabl_simp_c_stabl)
  have eq_equal_sides_subsumed:
    "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))
      (stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) - called (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))"
    using Repeat.prems(2,4) by simp

  show ?case using Repeat.IH(1) Repeat.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: repeat_unstable_stable_cases)
    case (Unstable state1 d1)
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Unstable(2) inv eq_equal_sides_subsumed, of "[]", simplified,
        OF Repeat.prems(2)]

    have "called state1 = called state"
      using c_same(4)[OF Unstable(1,2)] by simp
    then have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1"
      using Repeat.prems(2) by simp
    have inv1: "well_infl_stabl state1"
      using well_infl_stabl_ind(4)[OF Unstable(1,2) inv, of "[]", simplified, OF Repeat.prems(2)]
      by simp

    note ih = Repeat.IH(3)[OF Unstable(2) _ Unstable(3,5) x_in_c1 inv1 conjunct1[OF IH],
        of d1, simplified]

    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case Stable
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Stable(2) inv eq_equal_sides_subsumed, of "[]", simplified,
        OF Repeat.prems(2)]
    then show ?thesis using Stable(3) by simp
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (QueryL y g yd state1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(2)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) Eval.prems(2,3)]
    note well_infl_stabl_1 = well_infl_stabl_ind(1)[OF QueryL(3,4) Eval.prems(2)]

    have prefix_recorded_in_infl:
      "∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set pre}. x ∈ slookup (infl state) p" if "x ∈ stabl state"
      using Eval.prems(5) that by simp

    have prefix_no_indirect_side: "{p. Inl p ∈ set pre}
          ⊆ {u. ∃x ∈ called state ∩ stabl state1. x ∈ slookup (infl state) u}"
        if "x ∈ stabl state1"
      using lookup_in_influenced that called_non_stabl_increasing(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] Eval.prems(4)
        prefix_recorded_in_infl
      by fastforce

    have prefix_recorded_in_infl':
      "∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inl y)])}. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) p"
      if "x ∈ stabl state1"
    proof -
      have "∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set pre}. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) p"
        using prefix_recorded_in_infl called_non_stabl_increasing(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] that
          Eval.prems(4) well_infl_stabl_1 prefix_no_indirect_side by fastforce
      then show ?thesis using well_infl_stabl_1 by auto
    qed
    have prefix: "x ∈ stabl state1 ⟶
      (subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inl (Inl y)]) (σ state1) = Some (g yd)
      ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inl y)])}. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) p)
      ∧ (∀(u,ud) ∈ {s. Inr s ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inl y)])}. ud ≤ (σ state1) (Inr u)))"
    proof (intro impI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      have "x ∈ stabl state"
        using 1 called_non_stabl_increasing(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] Eval.prems(4) by auto
      then have pre0: "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state) = Some t"
        using Eval.prems(5) by simp
      then have pre1: "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state1) = Some t"
        apply (subst subt_for_prefix_same[of pre "σ state1" "σ state" "T x"])
        subgoal using 1 prefix_no_indirect_side well_infl_stabl_1  by fastforce
        subgoal by simp
        done
      have pre_sides_subsumed:
        "∀(u, ud)∈{s. Inr s ∈ set pre}. ud ≤ (σ state1) (Inr u)"
      proof -
        have "∀(u, ud) ∈ {s. Inr s ∈ set pre}. ud ≤ (σ state) (Inr u)"
          using Eval.prems(5) ‹x ∈ stabl state› by simp
        moreover have
          "∀(u, ud) ∈ {s. Inr s ∈ set pre}. (σ state) (Inr u) ≤ (σ state1) (Inr u)"
          using increasing_values_for_globals(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] by simp
        ultimately show ?thesis using order.trans by fastforce
      qed
      show ?case
        using pre1 QueryL(2,7) prefix_recorded_in_infl' 1 pre_sides_subsumed
          subt_for_prefix_transitive[of "T x" pre "σ state1" t "[Inl (Inl y)]" "g yd"]
        by auto
    qed

    have "called state1 = called state" using c_same(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] by simp
    then have "x ∈ called state1" using Eval.prems(4) by simp
    have "called state' = called state1" using c_same(4)[OF QueryL(5,6)] by simp

    note ih = Eval.IH(3)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) _ QueryL(6) conjunct1[OF well_infl_stabl_1] IH
        ‹x ∈ called state1› prefix, simplified]

    then show ?thesis using ih by simp
  next
    case (QueryG y g yd)
    have inv: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
      using Eval.prems(2)
      unfolding well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def
      by simp
    have prefix: "x ∈ stabl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈) ⟶ (
        subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inl (Inr y)])
        (σ (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)) = Some (g yd)
      ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inr y)])}. x ∈ slookup
        (infl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)) p)
      ∧ (∀(u, ud) ∈ {s. Inr s ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inr y)])}.
        ud ≤ (σ (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)) (Inr u)))"
      using Eval.prems(5) QueryG(2,3) subt_for_prefix_transitive[of "T x" pre _ t "[Inl (Inr y)]"]
      by (simp add: fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)

    note IH = Eval.IH(4)[OF QueryG(1-3,5) inv _ _ prefix, simplified, OF Eval.prems(3,4)]

    then show ?thesis using IH by simp
  next
    case (Side_Subsumed y yd d' t1)
    have "yd ≤ (σ state) (Inr y)"
      using Side_Subsumed(3,4) sup_ge2[of yd d'] by simp
    then have prefix: "x ∈ stabl state ⟶
      (subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) (σ state) = Some t1
      ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)])}. x ∈ slookup (infl state) p)
      ∧ (∀(u, ud) ∈ {s. Inr s ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)])}. ud ≤ (σ state) (Inr u)))"
      using Eval.prems(5) subt_for_prefix_transitive[of "T x" pre _ t "[Inr (y, yd)]" t1]
        Side_Subsumed(2)
      by simp

    note IH = Eval.IH(5)[OF Side_Subsumed(1-4,6) Eval.prems(2-4) prefix]

    show ?thesis using IH by simp
  next
    case (Side_Effect y yd d' t1 infl1 stabl1)
    have inv: "well_infl_stabl (state ⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1,
        σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
      using destab_upd_globale_preserves_well_infl_stabl[OF Side_Effect(5) Eval.prems(2)] by simp
    have x_stabl_if_stabl1: "x ∈ stabl state" if "x ∈ stabl1"
      using that destab_opt_infl_stabl_relation[OF Side_Effect(5)] by simp

    have prefix_recorded_in_infl:
      "∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set pre}. x ∈ slookup (infl state) p" if "x ∈ stabl state"
      using Eval.prems(5) that by simp

    have y_not_in_prefix: "Inl (Inr y) ∉ set pre" if "x ∈ stabl1"
    proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "x ∈ slookup (infl state) (Inr y)"
        using prefix_recorded_in_infl that x_stabl_if_stabl1 by simp
      then have "x ∈ influenced_by_cutoff (infl state) (Inr y) (Inl ` called state - {Inr y})"
        using lookup_in_influenced_cutoff by fastforce
      then show ?case using that destab_opt_infl_stabl_relation[OF Side_Effect(5)] by simp
    qed

    have prefix: "x ∈ stabl1 ⟶
      subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) = Some t1 ∧
      (∀p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) ⟶ x ∈ slookup infl1 p) ∧
      (∀a b. Inr (a, b) ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) ⟶ b ≤ ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) (Inr a))"
    proof (intro impI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "x ∈ stabl state" using x_stabl_if_stabl1 by simp
      show ?case using Eval.prems(5)[rule_format, OF ‹x ∈ stabl state›]
      proof (intro conjI impI allI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case
          apply (intro subt_for_prefix_transitive[where ?t2.0=t])
          subgoal
            apply (subst subt_for_prefix_same[where ?sigma'="(σ state)"])
            by (auto simp add: ‹x ∈ stabl1› fun_upd_def y_not_in_prefix)
          subgoal using Side_Effect(2) by simp
          done
      next
        case (2 p)
        then show ?case using influencing_stabl_after_destab'[OF Side_Effect(5) _ 1] by simp
      next
        case (3 a b)
        then show ?case
          by (auto intro: order.trans[OF _ sup_ge1] simp add: Side_Effect(3) fun_upd_def)
      qed
    qed

    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1:
      "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) (stabl1 - called state)"
      using destab_upd_globale_preserves_part_solution[OF Side_Effect(5) Eval.prems(3,2)
          Side_Effect(3)]
      by simp

    note IH = Eval.IH(6)[OF Side_Effect(1-5) _ Side_Effect(7) inv, simplified,
        OF eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 Eval.prems(4) prefix]

    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case Answer
    have "eq T x (σ state') = xd" if "x ∈ stabl state'"
    proof -
      have "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state) = Some t"
        using Eval.prems(5) Answer(3) that by simp
      then have "eq T x (σ state) = xd"
        using subt_for_prefix_Answer_eq_traverse Answer(2) by blast
      then show ?thesis using Answer(3) by simp
    qed
    moreover have "sides_of_rhs (T x) (σ state') ≤ σ state'" if "x ∈ stabl state'"
    proof -
      have "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state) = Some (Answer xd)"
        using Eval.prems(5) Answer that by simp
      then show ?thesis using subt_for_prefix_Answer_subsumes Eval.prems(5) that Answer(3) by blast
    qed
    ultimately show ?thesis using Eval.prems(3) Answer(3) by simp
  next
    case Abort
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(3) by force
  qed
qed

theorem partial_solution:
  assumes "solve_dom x"
      and "solve x = (st, sigma)"
    shows "part_solution T x sigma st"
proof -
  obtain d state where
    iterate: "(d, state) = iterate x (init_state ⦇ called := insert x (called init_state) ⦈)"
    and st: "st = stabl state" and sigma: "sigma = σ state"
    using assms(2) unfolding solve_def by (auto split: prod.splits)
  have c_empty: "called state = {}"
    using c_same(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] iterate]
    unfolding init_state_def
    by simp
  have well_init: "well_infl_stabl (init_state⦇called := called init_state - {x}⦈)"
    unfolding init_state_def well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def
    by simp
  then have well_result_state: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)"
    and x_stabl: "x ∈ stabl state"
    using well_infl_stabl_ind(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] iterate]
    by auto
  moreover have "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state)"
    using eq_equal_sides_subsumed_ind(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] iterate] c_empty
      well_init
    unfolding init_state_def
    by simp
  moreover have "∀u ∈ stabl state. dep⇩L T (σ state) u ⊆ stabl state"
    using well_infl_stabl_implies_stabl_c_closed[OF well_result_state] c_empty
    unfolding well_infl_stabl_def dep⇩L_def
    by simp
  ultimately show ?thesis using x_stabl st sigma by simp
qed

end ―‹end of context TD_side_opt›


subsection ‹Least Partial Post-Solution with Monotonicity and Abort for Optimized Solver›

locale TD_side_mono = TD_side_opt True T for
  T :: "'x ⇒ ('x, 'g, 'd :: bounded_semilattice_sup_bot) strategy_tree" +
  assumes mono_eq: "is_mono_eq T"
    and mono_sides: "mono_sides T"
    and mono_deps: "mono_deps T"
begin

subsubsection ‹Increasing Sigma and Upper Bound for Locales›

abbreviation locales_upper_bound :: "('x,'g,'d) state ⇒ bool" where
  "locales_upper_bound state ≡ ∀ξ. (σ state) (Inl ξ) ≤ eq T ξ (σ state)"

lemma locales_upper_bound_ind:
  shows "query_dom x y state
    ⟹ (yd, state') = query x y state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state'"
    and "iterate_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - (called state - {x}))
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state'"
    and "repeat_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = repeat x state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state'"
    and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state'"
proof(induction x y state and x state and x state and x t state
    arbitrary: yd state' and xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
    rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query x y state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {y}⦈)"
      using Query.prems(2) Iterate(5) by auto
    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed:
      "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - (called state - {y}))"
      using Query.prems(3) Iterate(5) by simp
    note IH = Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(5,2), simplified, OF well_infl_stabl eq_equal_sides_subsumed
        Query.prems(4)]
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: Iterate(3))
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis using Query.prems(2-4) by auto
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl state"
    using well_infl_stabl_simp_add_to_c[OF Iterate.prems(3)] by simp
  have eq_equal_sides_subsumed: "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)"
    using Iterate.prems(4) by simp
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(5) by simp
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(4,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl
        eq_equal_sides_subsumed Iterate.prems(5)]
    have "x ∈ stabl state1"
      using well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Fixpoint(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl] by simp
    then show ?thesis using IH by (auto simp add: Fixpoint(5))
  next
    case (Continue state1 xd_new infl2 stabl2)
    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(7,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl
        eq_equal_sides_subsumed Iterate.prems(5)]
    note well_infl_stabl_1 =
      well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl]
    note eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 = eq_equal_sides_subsumed_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2)
        Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl eq_equal_sides_subsumed]

    have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1" using c_same(3)[OF Continue(1,2)] Iterate.prems(2) by simp
    have well_infl_stabl_2: "well_infl_stabl (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
        σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
      apply (rule destab_upd_locale_preserves_well_infl_stabl[OF Continue(4)])
      using conjunct1[OF well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl]]
      unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
      by auto
    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed_2:
      "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) (stabl2 - (called state1 - {x}))"
      apply (rule destab_upd_locale_preserves_part_solution[OF Continue(4)])
      using IH well_infl_stabl_1 eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 x_in_c1 by simp+

    have "σ state1 ≤ (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)"
    proof -
      have "eq T x (σ state1) = xd_new" using eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 by simp
      moreover have "σ state1 (Inl x) ≤ eq T x (σ state1)" using IH by simp
      ultimately have "σ state1 (Inl x) ≤ xd_new" by simp
      then show ?thesis
        apply (intro le_funI)
        subgoal for a
          by (cases "a = Inl x") (auto simp add: fun_upd_same fun_upd_other)
        done
    qed
    then have "eq T z (σ state1) ≤ eq T z ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new))" for z
      using mono_eq unfolding is_mono_eq_def by blast
    then have inv_2:
        "∀ξ. ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) (Inl ξ) ≤ eq T ξ ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new))"
      apply (intro allI)
      subgoal for y
        apply (cases "x = y")
        subgoal
          using eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same)
        subgoal
          using IH
          by (auto intro: order_trans[of _ "eq T y (σ state1)"] simp add: fun_upd_other)
        done
      done

    note ih = Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(7,2) _ Continue(3,4) _ Continue(6), simplified, OF x_in_c1
        well_infl_stabl_2 eq_equal_sides_subsumed_2 inv_2]

    show ?thesis
      using IH ih ‹σ state1 ≤ (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)› order.trans
      by meson
  qed
next
  case (Repeat x state)
  have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using Repeat.prems(2,3) by (simp add: well_infl_stabl_simp_c_stabl)
  have eq_equal_sides_subsumed:
    "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))
      (stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) - called (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))"
    using Repeat.prems(2,4) by simp
  have inv: "locales_upper_bound (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using Repeat.prems(5) by simp

  show ?case using Repeat.IH(1) Repeat.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: repeat_unstable_stable_cases)
    case (Unstable state1 d1)
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Unstable(2) well_infl_stabl eq_equal_sides_subsumed inv]

    have "called state1 = called state"
      using c_same(4)[OF Unstable(1,2)] by simp
    then have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1"
      using Repeat.prems(2) by simp
    have well_infl_stabl_1: "well_infl_stabl state1"
      using well_infl_stabl_ind(4)[OF Unstable(1,2) well_infl_stabl, of "[]", simplified,
          OF Repeat.prems(2)]
      by simp
    note part_sol_1 = eq_equal_sides_subsumed_ind(4)[OF Unstable(1,2) well_infl_stabl, of "[]",
        simplified, OF Repeat.prems(4,2)]
    have inv_1: "locales_upper_bound state1" using IH by simp

    note ih = Repeat.IH(3)[OF Unstable(2) _ Unstable(3,5) x_in_c1 well_infl_stabl_1
        conjunct1[OF part_sol_1] inv_1, of d1, simplified]

    then show ?thesis using IH order.trans by fastforce
  next
    case Stable
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Stable(2) well_infl_stabl eq_equal_sides_subsumed inv]
    then show ?thesis using Stable(3) by simp
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (QueryL y g yd state1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(2)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) Eval.prems(2-4)]
    note well_infl_stabl_1 = well_infl_stabl_ind(1)[OF QueryL(3,4) Eval.prems(2)]
    note part_sol_1 = eq_equal_sides_subsumed_ind(1)[OF QueryL(3,4) Eval.prems(2,3)]
    note ih = Eval.IH(3)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) _ QueryL(6) conjunct1[OF well_infl_stabl_1] part_sol_1
      IH, simplified]
    show ?thesis using QueryL IH ih by (auto simp add: Un_assoc)
  next
    case (QueryG y g yd)
    have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
      using Eval.prems(2) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def
      by simp
    note IH = Eval.IH(4)[OF QueryG(1-3) QueryG(5), simplified, OF well_infl_stabl Eval.prems(3,4)]
    show ?thesis using IH by simp
  next
    case (Side_Subsumed y yd d' t1)
    have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
      using Eval.prems(2) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def
      by simp
    note IH = Eval.IH(5)[OF Side_Subsumed(1-4,6) Eval.prems(2-4)]
    show ?thesis using IH by simp
  next
    case (Side_Effect y yd d' t1 infl1 stabl1)
    have well_infl_stabl:
      "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
      using destab_upd_globale_preserves_well_infl_stabl[OF Side_Effect(5) Eval.prems(2)] by simp
    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed:
      "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) (stabl1 - called state)"
      using destab_upd_globale_preserves_part_solution Side_Effect(3,5) Eval.prems(3,2) by blast
    have inv: "locales_upper_bound (state⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1,
      σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
      apply (intro allI)
      subgoal for z
      proof -
        have "σ state ≤ (σ state)(Inr y := d')"
          apply (intro le_funI)
          subgoal for z
            apply (cases "Inr y = z")
            by (auto simp add: Side_Effect(3) fun_upd_same fun_upd_other)
          done
        then have "eq T z (σ state) ≤ eq T z ((σ state)(Inr y := d'))"
          using mono_eq unfolding is_mono_eq_def by blast
        moreover have "σ state (Inl z) ≤ eq T z (σ state)" using Eval.prems(4) by blast
        ultimately show ?thesis by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other)
      qed
      done
    note IH = Eval.IH(6)[OF Side_Effect(1-5) _ Side_Effect(7) well_infl_stabl _ inv, simplified,
        OF eq_equal_sides_subsumed]
    have "σ state ≤ (σ state)(Inr y := d')"
      using Side_Effect(3)
      apply (intro le_funI)
      subgoal for a
        by (cases "a = Inr y") (auto simp add: fun_upd_same fun_upd_other)
      done
    then show ?thesis using IH order.trans by blast
  next
    case (Abort)
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(4) by fast
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(4) by simp
  qed
qed


lemma increasing_sigma:
  shows "query_dom x y state
    ⟹ (yd, state') = query x y state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state
    ⟹ σ state ≤ σ state'"
    and "iterate_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - (called state - {x}))
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state
    ⟹ σ state ≤ σ state'"
    and "repeat_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = repeat x state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state
    ⟹ σ state ≤ σ state'"
    and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state
    ⟹ σ state ≤ σ state'"
proof(induction x y state and x state and x state and x t state
    arbitrary: yd state' and xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
    rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query x y state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {y}⦈)"
      using Query.prems(2) Iterate(5) by auto
    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed:
      "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - (called state - {y}))"
      using Query.prems(3) Iterate(5) by simp
    note IH = Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(5,2), simplified, OF well_infl_stabl eq_equal_sides_subsumed
        Query.prems(4)]
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: Iterate(3))
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis using Query.prems(2-4) by auto
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl state"
    using well_infl_stabl_simp_add_to_c[OF Iterate.prems(3)] by simp
  have eq_equal_sides_subsumed: "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)"
    using Iterate.prems(4) by simp
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(5) by simp
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(4,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl
        eq_equal_sides_subsumed Iterate.prems(5)]
    have "x ∈ stabl state1"
      using well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Fixpoint(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl] by simp
    then show ?thesis using IH by (auto simp add: Fixpoint(5))
  next
    case (Continue state1 xd_new infl2 stabl2)
    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(7,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl
        eq_equal_sides_subsumed Iterate.prems(5)]
    note well_infl_stabl_1 =
      well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl]
    note eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 = eq_equal_sides_subsumed_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2)
        Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl eq_equal_sides_subsumed]
    note locales_upper_bound_1 = locales_upper_bound_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2)
        well_infl_stabl eq_equal_sides_subsumed Iterate.prems(5)]

    have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1" using c_same(3)[OF Continue(1,2)] Iterate.prems(2) by simp
    have well_infl_stabl_2: "well_infl_stabl (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
        σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
      apply (rule destab_upd_locale_preserves_well_infl_stabl[OF Continue(4)])
      using conjunct1[OF well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl]]
      unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
      by auto
    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed_2:
      "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) (stabl2 - (called state1 - {x}))"
      apply (rule destab_upd_locale_preserves_part_solution[OF Continue(4)])
      using IH well_infl_stabl_1 eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 x_in_c1 by simp+

    have "σ state1 ≤ (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)"
    proof -
      have "eq T x (σ state1) = xd_new" using eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 by simp
      moreover have "σ state1 (Inl x) ≤ eq T x (σ state1)"
        using locales_upper_bound_1 by simp
      ultimately have "σ state1 (Inl x) ≤ xd_new" by simp
      then show ?thesis
        apply (intro le_funI)
        subgoal for a
          by (cases "a = Inl x") (auto simp add: fun_upd_same fun_upd_other)
        done
    qed
    then have "eq T z (σ state1) ≤ eq T z ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new))" for z
      using mono_eq unfolding is_mono_eq_def by blast
    then have inv_2:
        "∀ξ. ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) (Inl ξ) ≤ eq T ξ ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new))"
      apply (intro allI)
      subgoal for y
        apply (cases "x = y")
        subgoal
          using eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same)
        subgoal
          using IH locales_upper_bound_1
          by (auto intro: order_trans[of _ "eq T y (σ state1)"] simp add: fun_upd_other)
        done
      done

    note ih = Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(7,2) _ Continue(3,4) _ Continue(6), simplified, OF x_in_c1
        well_infl_stabl_2 eq_equal_sides_subsumed_2 inv_2]

    show ?thesis
      using IH ih ‹σ state1 ≤ (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)› order.trans
      by meson
  qed
next
  case (Repeat x state)
  have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using Repeat.prems(2,3) by (simp add: well_infl_stabl_simp_c_stabl)
  have eq_equal_sides_subsumed:
    "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))
      (stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) - called (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))"
    using Repeat.prems(2,4) by simp
  have inv: "locales_upper_bound (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using Repeat.prems(5) by simp

  show ?case using Repeat.IH(1) Repeat.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: repeat_unstable_stable_cases)
    case (Unstable state1 d1)
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Unstable(2) well_infl_stabl eq_equal_sides_subsumed inv]

    have "called state1 = called state"
      using c_same(4)[OF Unstable(1,2)] by simp
    then have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1"
      using Repeat.prems(2) by simp
    have well_infl_stabl_1: "well_infl_stabl state1"
      using well_infl_stabl_ind(4)[OF Unstable(1,2) well_infl_stabl, of "[]", simplified,
          OF Repeat.prems(2)]
      by simp
    note part_sol_1 = eq_equal_sides_subsumed_ind(4)[OF Unstable(1,2) well_infl_stabl, of "[]",
        simplified, OF Repeat.prems(4,2)]
    have locales_upper_bound_1: "locales_upper_bound state1"
      using locales_upper_bound_ind(4)[OF Unstable(1,2) well_infl_stabl eq_equal_sides_subsumed]
        Repeat.prems(5) by simp

    note ih = Repeat.IH(3)[OF Unstable(2) _ Unstable(3,5) x_in_c1 well_infl_stabl_1
        conjunct1[OF part_sol_1] locales_upper_bound_1, of d1, simplified]

    then show ?thesis using IH order.trans by fastforce
  next
    case Stable
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Stable(2) well_infl_stabl eq_equal_sides_subsumed inv]
    then show ?thesis using Stable(3) by simp
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (QueryL y g yd state1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(2)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) Eval.prems(2-4)]
    note well_infl_stabl_1 = well_infl_stabl_ind(1)[OF QueryL(3,4) Eval.prems(2)]
    note part_sol_1 = eq_equal_sides_subsumed_ind(1)[OF QueryL(3,4) Eval.prems(2,3)]
    note locales_upper_bound_1 = locales_upper_bound_ind(1)[OF QueryL(3,4) Eval.prems(2,3,4)]
    note ih = Eval.IH(3)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) _ QueryL(6) conjunct1[OF well_infl_stabl_1] part_sol_1
      locales_upper_bound_1, simplified]
    have "σ state ≤ σ state'" using IH ih unfolding map_le_def
      by (meson dual_order.trans)
    then show ?thesis
      using QueryL IH ih by (auto simp add: Un_assoc)
  next
    case (QueryG y g yd)
    have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
      using Eval.prems(2) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def
      by simp
    note IH = Eval.IH(4)[OF QueryG(1-3) QueryG(5), simplified, OF well_infl_stabl Eval.prems(3,4)]
    show ?thesis using IH by simp
  next
    case (Side_Subsumed y yd d' t1)
    have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
      using Eval.prems(2) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def
      by simp
    note IH = Eval.IH(5)[OF Side_Subsumed(1-4,6) Eval.prems(2-4)]
    show ?thesis using IH by simp
  next
    case (Side_Effect y yd d' t1 infl1 stabl1)
    have well_infl_stabl:
      "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
      using destab_upd_globale_preserves_well_infl_stabl[OF Side_Effect(5) Eval.prems(2)] by simp
    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed:
      "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) (stabl1 - called state)"
      using destab_upd_globale_preserves_part_solution Side_Effect(3,5) Eval.prems(3,2) by blast
    have inv: "locales_upper_bound (state⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1,
      σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
      apply (intro allI)
      subgoal for z
      proof -
        have "σ state ≤ (σ state)(Inr y := d')"
          apply (intro le_funI)
          subgoal for z
            apply (cases "Inr y = z")
            by (auto simp add: Side_Effect(3) fun_upd_same fun_upd_other)
          done
        then have "eq T z (σ state) ≤ eq T z ((σ state)(Inr y := d'))"
          using mono_eq unfolding is_mono_eq_def by blast
        moreover have "σ state (Inl z) ≤ eq T z (σ state)" using Eval.prems(4) by blast
        ultimately show ?thesis by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other)
      qed
      done
    note IH = Eval.IH(6)[OF Side_Effect(1-5) _ Side_Effect(7) well_infl_stabl _ inv, simplified,
        OF eq_equal_sides_subsumed]
    have "σ state ≤ (σ state)(Inr y := d')"
      using Side_Effect(3)
      apply (intro le_funI)
      subgoal for a
        by (cases "a = Inr y") (auto simp add: fun_upd_same fun_upd_other)
      done
    then show ?thesis using IH order.trans by blast
  next
    case (Abort)
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(4) by fast
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(4) by simp
  qed
qed

subsubsection ‹Least Partial Solution›

lemma mono_trans_dep⇩L: "sigma1 ≤ sigma2 ⟹ trans_dep⇩L T sigma1 x ⊆ trans_dep⇩L T sigma2 x"
proof
  fix u
  assume A: "sigma1 ≤ sigma2" "u ∈ trans_dep⇩L T sigma1 x"
  have "(x, u) ∈ trans_dep⇩L_rel T sigma1" using A(2) by blast
  then have "(x, u) ∈ trans_dep⇩L_rel T sigma2"
  proof (induction rule: trancl.induct)
    case (r_into_trancl u d)
    then have "d ∈ dep⇩L T sigma2 u" using mono_deps A(1) unfolding mono_deps_def dep⇩L_def by auto
    then show ?case by blast
  next
    case (trancl_into_trancl v u d)
    then have "d ∈ dep⇩L T sigma2 u" using mono_deps A(1) unfolding mono_deps_def dep⇩L_def by auto
    then have "(u,d) ∈ trans_dep⇩L_rel T sigma2" by blast
    then show ?case using trancl_into_trancl(3) by simp
  qed
  then show "u ∈ trans_dep⇩L T sigma2 x" by blast
qed

abbreviation less_than_least :: "'x ⇒ ('x, 'g, 'd) state ⇒ bool" where
  "less_than_least x state ≡
    (∀σl varsl. part_post_solution T x σl varsl ⟶ σ state ≤ σl ∧ stabl state ⊆ varsl)"

lemma less_than_part_post_solution_ind:
  shows "query_dom x y state
    ⟹ (yd, state') = query x y state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state
    ⟹ less_than_least z state
    ⟹ y ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ state) z)
    ⟹ less_than_least z state'"
    and "iterate_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - (called state - {x}))
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state
    ⟹ less_than_least z state
    ⟹ x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ state) z)
    ⟹ less_than_least z state'"
    and "repeat_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = repeat x state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state
    ⟹ less_than_least z state
    ⟹ x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ state) z)
    ⟹ less_than_least z state'"
    and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
    ⟹ well_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)
    ⟹ locales_upper_bound state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ less_than_least z state
    ⟹ x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ state) z)
    ⟹ x ∈ stabl state ⟶ (subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state) = Some t
        ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set pre}. x ∈ slookup (infl state) p))
    ⟹ less_than_least z state'"
proof(induction x y state and x state and x state and x t state
    arbitrary: yd state' and xd state' and xd state' and xd state' pre
    rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query x y state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {y}⦈)"
      using Query.prems(2) Iterate(5) by auto
    have part_sol: "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - (called state - {y}))"
      using Query.prems(3) Iterate(5) by simp
    have stabl_subset_P: "y ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ (state⦇called := insert y (called state)⦈)) z)"
      using Query.prems(6) Iterate(3) by simp
    have less_than: "less_than_least z (state⦇called := insert y (called state)⦈)"
      using Query.prems(5) by auto
    note IH = Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(5,2) _ _ _ _ less_than stabl_subset_P, simplified,
        OF well_infl_stabl part_sol Query.prems(4)]
    show ?thesis using IH by (auto simp add: Iterate(3))
  next
    case Lookup
    show ?thesis using Query.prems(5) Lookup(2) by auto
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl state"
    using well_infl_stabl_simp_add_to_c[OF Iterate.prems(3)] by simp
  have part_sol: "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (stabl state - called state)"
    using Iterate.prems(4) by simp
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    show ?thesis using Stable(1) Iterate.prems(6) by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    have "σ state1 ≤ σ state'"
      using Fixpoint(5) by simp
    have subset_P: "x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ state) z)"
      using Iterate.prems(7)
      by (simp add: Fixpoint(5))
    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(4,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl part_sol
        Iterate.prems(5,6) subset_P]
    have "x ∈ stabl state1"
      using well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Fixpoint(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl] by simp
    show ?thesis using IH by (auto simp add: Fixpoint(5))
  next
    case (Continue state1 xd_new infl2 stabl2)
    have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1" using c_same(3)[OF Continue(1,2)] Iterate.prems(2) by simp

    note well_infl_stabl_1 =
      well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl]
    note part_sol_1 = eq_equal_sides_subsumed_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2)
      well_infl_stabl part_sol]
    note incr_sigma_1 = increasing_sigma(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl
      part_sol Iterate.prems(5)]
    note locales_upper_bound_1 = locales_upper_bound_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2)
      well_infl_stabl part_sol Iterate.prems(5)]

    have well_infl_stabl_2: "well_infl_stabl (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
        σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
      apply (rule destab_upd_locale_preserves_well_infl_stabl[OF Continue(4)])
      using conjunct1[OF well_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl]]
      unfolding well_infl_stabl_def
      by auto
    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed_2:
      "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) (stabl2 - (called state1 - {x}))"
      apply (rule destab_upd_locale_preserves_part_solution[OF Continue(4)])
      using well_infl_stabl_1 part_sol_1 x_in_c1 by simp+

    have sigma_smaller_upd: "σ state1 ≤ (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)"
    proof -
      have "xd_new = eq T x (σ state1)" using part_sol_1 by simp
      then have "σ state1 (Inl x) ≤ xd_new" using locales_upper_bound_1 by simp
      then show ?thesis
        apply (intro le_funI)
        subgoal for a
          by (cases "a = Inl x") (auto simp add: fun_upd_same fun_upd_other)
        done
    qed

    have locales_ub_2: "locales_upper_bound (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
        σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)⦈)"
    proof -
      have "eq T z (σ state1) ≤ eq T z ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new))" for z
        using sigma_smaller_upd mono_eq unfolding is_mono_eq_def by blast
      then show ?thesis
        apply (intro allI)
        subgoal for y
          apply (cases "x = y")
          subgoal
            using part_sol_1 by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same)
          subgoal
            using increasing_sigma(3)[OF Continue(1,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl part_sol
              Iterate.prems(5)] locales_upper_bound_1
            by (auto intro: order_trans[of _ "eq T y (σ state1)"] simp add: fun_upd_other)
          done
        done
    qed

    have "σ state1 ≤ σ state'"
      using increasing_sigma(2)[OF Continue(5,6) _ _ _ locales_ub_2, simplified,
          OF x_in_c1 well_infl_stabl_2 eq_equal_sides_subsumed_2] sigma_smaller_upd
      by auto
    then have subset_P: "x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ state) z)"
      using Iterate.prems(7) mono_trans_dep⇩L
      by blast
    note IH = Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(7,2) Iterate.prems(2) well_infl_stabl part_sol
        Iterate.prems(5,6) subset_P]

    have less_inv_2: "less_than_least z (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
        σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)⦈)"
    proof (intro allI impI)
      fix σl varsl y
      assume P: "part_post_solution T z σl varsl"
      have "(σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new) ≤ σl"
      proof (intro conjI le_funI, goal_cases)
        case (1 y)
        show ?case
        proof (cases "y = Inl x")
          case True
          have "σ state ≤ σl" using Iterate.prems(6) P by auto
          then have "x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T σl z)" using mono_trans_dep⇩L subset_P by blast
          then have x_varsl: "x ∈ varsl"
            using part_post_solution_implies_trans_dep_subsumed[of z] P by auto
          have "xd_new = eq T x (σ state1)" using part_sol_1 by auto
          moreover have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ eq T x σl"
          proof -
            have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ eq T x ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new))"
              using mono_eq ‹σ state1 ≤ (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)›
              unfolding is_mono_eq_def by blast
            moreover have "eq T x ((σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)) ≤ eq T x σl"
            proof -
              have "σ state1 ≤ σl" using IH P by auto
              then have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ eq T x σl"
                using mono_eq unfolding is_mono_eq_def by blast
              then have "xd_new ≤ eq T x σl" by (simp add: ‹xd_new = eq T x (σ state1)›)
              have "xd_new ≤ σl (Inl x)"
                using ‹xd_new ≤ eq T x σl› P x_varsl by auto
              then have "(σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new) ≤ σl"
                using ‹σ state1 ≤ σl›
                apply (intro le_funI)
                subgoal for a
                  by (cases "a = Inl x") (auto simp add: le_funD fun_upd_same fun_upd_other)
                done
              then show ?thesis using mono_eq unfolding is_mono_eq_def by blast
            qed
            ultimately show ?thesis by simp
          qed
          moreover have "eq T x σl ≤ σl (Inl x)"
            using P IH x_varsl by blast
          ultimately show ?thesis by (simp add: True fun_upd_same)
        next
          case False
          have "σ state1 ≤ σl" using IH P by blast
          then show ?thesis using False by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other le_fun_def)
        qed
      qed
      moreover have "stabl2 ⊆ varsl"
        using IH P destab_opt_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(4)] by blast
      ultimately show
        "σ (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)⦈) ≤ σl
        ∧ stabl (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)⦈) ⊆ varsl"
        by auto
    qed
    have "x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ state1) z)"
      using Iterate.prems(7) mono_trans_dep⇩L[OF incr_sigma_1] by blast
    then have in_trans_dep: "x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T
          (σ (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)⦈)) z)"
      using mono_trans_dep⇩L[OF ‹σ state1 ≤ (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)›]
      by auto

    note ih = Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(7,2) _ Continue(3,4) _ Continue(6) _ _ _ locales_ub_2
        less_inv_2 in_trans_dep, simplified, OF x_in_c1 well_infl_stabl_2 eq_equal_sides_subsumed_2]

    show ?thesis
      using IH ih ‹σ state1 ≤ (σ state1)(Inl x := xd_new)› order.trans
      by meson
  qed
next
  case (Repeat x state)
  have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using Repeat.prems(2,3) by (simp add: well_infl_stabl_simp_c_stabl)
  have eq_equal_sides_subsumed:
    "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))
      (stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) - called (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))"
    using Repeat.prems(2,4) by simp
  have less_than: "less_than_least z (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
  proof (intro allI impI, goal_cases)
    case (1 σl varsl)
    then have "σ state ≤ σl" using Repeat.prems(6) by auto
    have "insert z (trans_dep⇩L T σl z) ⊆ varsl"
      using part_post_solution_implies_trans_dep_subsumed[OF 1] 1 by simp
    then have "insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ state) z) ⊆ varsl"
      using ‹σ state ≤ σl› mono_trans_dep⇩L by blast
    then have "x ∈ varsl" using Repeat.prems(7) by blast
    then show ?case using Repeat.prems(6) 1 by auto
  qed
  have subset_trans: "x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)) z)"
    using Repeat.prems(7) by simp

  show ?case using Repeat.IH(1) Repeat.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: repeat_unstable_stable_cases)
    case (Unstable state1 d1)

    have "called state1 = called state"
      using c_same(4)[OF Unstable(1,2)] by simp
    then have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1"
      using Repeat.prems(2) by simp
    have well_infl_stabl_1: "well_infl_stabl state1"
      using well_infl_stabl_ind(4)[OF Unstable(1,2) well_infl_stabl, of "[]", simplified,
          OF Repeat.prems(2)]
      by simp
    note eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 = eq_equal_sides_subsumed_ind(4)[OF Unstable(1,2)
        well_infl_stabl, of "[]", simplified, OF Repeat.prems(4,2)]
    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed:
      "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T (σ state) (insert x (stabl state) - called state)"
      using Repeat.prems(2,4) by simp
    note incr_sigma_1 = increasing_sigma(4)[OF Unstable(1,2) well_infl_stabl, simplified,
        OF eq_equal_sides_subsumed Repeat.prems(5)]
    note locales_upper_bound_1 = locales_upper_bound_ind(4)[OF Unstable(1,2) well_infl_stabl,
        simplified, OF eq_equal_sides_subsumed Repeat.prems(5)]
    note incr_sigma_2 = increasing_sigma(3)[OF Unstable(4,5) x_in_c1 well_infl_stabl_1
        conjunct1[OF eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1] locales_upper_bound_1]

    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Unstable(2) well_infl_stabl _ _ _ less_than subset_trans, of "[]",
        simplified, OF Repeat.prems(4,5,2)]

    have subset_trans_1: "x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ state1) z)"
      using mono_trans_dep⇩L[OF incr_sigma_1] Repeat.prems(7) by blast
    note ih = Repeat.IH(3)[OF Unstable(2) _ Unstable(3,5) x_in_c1 well_infl_stabl_1
        conjunct1[OF eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1] locales_upper_bound_1 _ subset_trans_1,
        of d1, simplified, OF IH]

    show ?thesis using ih by auto
  next
    case Stable
    note IH = Repeat.IH(2)[OF Stable(2) well_infl_stabl eq_equal_sides_subsumed _ _ less_than
        subset_trans, of "[]", simplified, OF Repeat.prems(5,2)]
    then show ?thesis using Stable(3) by auto
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (QueryL y g yd state1)
    have "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state) = Some t" using Eval.prems(8) QueryL(1) by simp
    then have "subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inl (Inl y)]) (σ state) = Some (g ((σ state) (Inl y)))"
      by (rule subt_for_prefix_transitive[where ?pre2.0="[Inl (Inl y)]"])
         (simp add: QueryL(2))
    then have y_dep_x: "y ∈ dep⇩L T (σ state) x"
      using subt_for_prefix_subset_dep[of "T x" "pre @ [Inl (Inl y)]" "σ state"]
      unfolding dep⇩L_def dep_def by auto
    note well_infl_stabl_1 = well_infl_stabl_ind(1)[OF QueryL(3,4) Eval.prems(2)]
    note locales_upper_bound_1 = locales_upper_bound_ind(1)[OF QueryL(3,4) Eval.prems(2,3,4)]
    note eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 = eq_equal_sides_subsumed_ind(1)[OF QueryL(3,4) Eval.prems(2,3)]
    note incr_sigma_1 = increasing_sigma(1)[OF QueryL(3,4) Eval.prems(2-4)]
    have x_in_c1: "x ∈ called state1" using c_same(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] Eval.prems(5) by simp
    note incr_sigma' = increasing_sigma(4)[OF QueryL(5,6) conjunct1[OF well_infl_stabl_1]
        eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 locales_upper_bound_1]

    have "σ state ≤ σ state'" using incr_sigma' incr_sigma_1 by auto
    then have y_dep_x': "y ∈ dep⇩L T (σ state') x"
      using y_dep_x mono_deps unfolding mono_deps_def dep_def dep⇩L_def by auto
    have "y ∈ trans_dep⇩L T (σ state) x"
      using trancl.r_into_trancl y_dep_x by blast
    then have subset_trans: "y ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ state) z)"
      using Eval.prems(7) trancl_trans by fastforce

    note IH = Eval.IH(2)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) Eval.prems(2-4) Eval.prems(6) subset_trans]

    have prefix_no_indirect_side: "{p. Inl p ∈ set pre}
        ⊆ {u. ∃x ∈ called state ∩ stabl state1. x ∈ slookup (infl state) u}" if "x ∈ stabl state1"
      using that Eval.prems(5,8) QueryL(1) by blast

    have prefix: "x ∈ stabl state1 ⟶
      (subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inl (Inl y)]) (σ state1) = Some (g yd)
      ∧ (∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inl y)])}. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) p))"
    proof (intro impI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "x ∈ stabl state"
        using called_non_stabl_increasing(1)[OF QueryL(3,4)] Eval.prems(5) by blast
      show ?case using Eval.prems(8)[rule_format, OF ‹x ∈ stabl state›]
      proof (intro conjI impI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case
          apply (intro subt_for_prefix_transitive[where ?t2.0=t])
          subgoal
            apply (subst subt_for_prefix_same[where ?sigma'="(σ state)"])
            subgoal using prefix_no_indirect_side ‹x ∈ stabl state1› well_infl_stabl_1 by fastforce
            subgoal by simp
            done
          subgoal using QueryL(2,7) by simp
          done
      next
        case 2
        then show ?case
          using conjunct2[OF well_infl_stabl_1] prefix_no_indirect_side[OF 1] by fastforce
      qed
    qed

    have subset_trans_1: "x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ state1) z)"
      using mono_trans_dep⇩L[OF incr_sigma_1] Eval.prems(7) by blast
    note ih = Eval.IH(3)[OF QueryL(1,2,4) _ QueryL(6) conjunct1[OF well_infl_stabl_1]
        eq_equal_sides_subsumed_1 locales_upper_bound_1 x_in_c1 IH subset_trans_1 prefix,
        simplified]
    then show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case (QueryG y g yd)
    have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
      using Eval.prems(2) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def
      by simp
    have pre: "x ∈ stabl state ⟶
      subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inl (Inr y)]) (σ state) = Some (g yd) ∧
      (∀p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inl (Inr y)]) ⟶ x ∈ slookup (fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x) p)"
      using Eval.prems(8) QueryG(2,3) subt_for_prefix_transitive[of "T x" pre _ t "[Inl (Inr y)]"]
      by (simp add: fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)
    have less_than: "less_than_least z (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
      using Eval.prems(6) by auto
    have subset_trans:
      "x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T (σ (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)) z)"
      using Eval.prems(7) by simp
    note IH = Eval.IH(4)[OF QueryG(1-3) QueryG(5) _ _ _ _ less_than subset_trans, simplified,
        OF well_infl_stabl Eval.prems(3-5) pre]
    show ?thesis using IH by auto
  next
    case (Side_Subsumed y yd d' t1)
    have well_infl_stabl: "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)"
      using Eval.prems(2) unfolding well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def
      by simp
    have pre: "x ∈ stabl state ⟶
      subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inr (y,yd)]) (σ state) = Some t1 ∧
      (∀p∈{p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y,yd)])}. x ∈ slookup (infl state) p)"
      using Eval.prems(8) subt_for_prefix_transitive[of "T x" pre _ t "[Inr (y, yd)]" t1]
        Side_Subsumed(2)
      by simp
    note IH = Eval.IH(5)[OF Side_Subsumed(1-4,6) Eval.prems(2-7) pre]
    show ?thesis using IH by auto
  next
    case (Side_Effect y yd d' t1 infl1 stabl1)
    have well_infl_stabl:
      "well_infl_stabl (state⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
      using destab_upd_globale_preserves_well_infl_stabl[OF Side_Effect(5) Eval.prems(2)] by simp
    have eq_equal_sides_subsumed:
      "eq_equal_sides_subsumed T ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) (stabl1 - called state)"
      using destab_upd_globale_preserves_part_solution Side_Effect(3,5) Eval.prems(3,2) by blast
    have locale_ub: "locales_upper_bound (state⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1,
      σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
      apply (intro allI)
      subgoal for z
      proof -
        have "σ state ≤ (σ state)(Inr y := d')"
          apply (intro le_funI)
          subgoal for z
            apply (cases "Inr y = z")
            by (auto simp add: Side_Effect(3) fun_upd_same fun_upd_other)
          done
        then have "eq T z (σ state) ≤ eq T z ((σ state)(Inr y := d'))"
          using mono_eq unfolding is_mono_eq_def by blast
        moreover have "σ state (Inl z) ≤ eq T z (σ state)" using Eval.prems(4) by blast
        ultimately show ?thesis by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other)
      qed
      done
    have less_inv:
      "less_than_least z (state⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)"
    proof (intro allI impI)
      fix σl varsl
      assume P: "part_post_solution T z σl varsl"
      then have "σ state ≤ σl" "stabl state ⊆ varsl" using Eval.prems(6) by auto
      moreover have "d' ≤ σl (Inr y)"
        apply (auto simp add: Side_Effect(3))
        subgoal using ‹σ state ≤ σl› by (simp add: le_funD)
        subgoal
        proof -
          have "yd ≤ sides_of_rhs (T x) (σ state) (Inr y)"
            using sides_of_rhs_helper[of "T x" pre "σ state" y yd t1] Eval.prems(8)
              Side_Effect(1,2)
            by blast
          moreover have "sides_of_rhs (T x) (σ state) (Inr y) ≤ sides_of_rhs (T x) σl (Inr y)"
            using ‹σ state ≤ σl› mono_sides unfolding mono_sides_def by (simp add: le_funD)
          moreover have "sides_of_rhs (T x) σl (Inr y) ≤ σl (Inr y)"
          proof -
            have "x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T σl z)"
              using Eval.prems(7) mono_trans_dep⇩L[OF ‹σ state ≤ σl›] by blast
            then have "x ∈ varsl"
              using part_post_solution_implies_trans_dep_subsumed[of z] P by blast
            then have "sides_of_rhs (T x) σl ≤ σl"
              using ‹part_post_solution T z σl varsl› Eval.prems(6)by blast
            then show ?thesis by (simp add: le_fun_def)
          qed
          ultimately show ?thesis
            using Eval.prems(6) ‹part_post_solution T z σl varsl› by auto
        qed
        done
      ultimately show "σ (state⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈) ≤ σl
        ∧ stabl (state⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈) ⊆ varsl"
        apply (intro conjI le_funI)
        subgoal for z
          by (cases "z = Inr y") (auto elim: le_funE simp add: fun_upd_same fun_upd_other)
        subgoal
          using destab_opt_infl_stabl_relation[OF Side_Effect(5)] by auto
        done
    qed

    (* Derive prefix for IH: *)
    have prefix_recorded_in_infl:
      "∀p ∈ {p. Inl p ∈ set pre}. x ∈ slookup (infl state) p" if "x ∈ stabl state"
      using Eval.prems(8) that by simp
    have y_not_in_prefix: "Inl (Inr y) ∉ set pre" if "x ∈ stabl1"
    proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then have "x ∈ slookup (infl state) (Inr y)"
        using prefix_recorded_in_infl that Side_Effect(1) by simp
      then have "x ∈ influenced_by_cutoff (infl state) (Inr y) (Inl ` called state - {Inr y})"
        using lookup_in_influenced_cutoff by fast
      then show ?case using destab_opt_infl_stabl_relation[OF Side_Effect(5)] that by simp
    qed
    have pre: "x ∈ stabl1 ⟶
      subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inr (y,yd)]) ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) = Some t1 ∧
      (∀p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y,yd)]) ⟶ x ∈ slookup infl1 p)"
    proof
      assume A: "x ∈ stabl1"
      have P: "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) = Some t"
        apply (subst subt_for_prefix_same[where ?sigma'="(σ state)"])
        subgoal using y_not_in_prefix A by (simp add: fun_upd_apply)
        subgoal using Eval.prems(8) Side_Effect(1) A by simp
        done
      show "subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) ((σ state)(Inr y := d')) = Some t1 ∧
        (∀p. Inl p ∈ set (pre @ [Inr (y, yd)]) ⟶ x ∈ slookup infl1 p)"
        apply (intro conjI)
        apply (subst subt_for_prefix_transitive[OF P(1), of "[Inr (y, yd)]" t1])
        subgoal using Side_Effect(2) by simp
        subgoal by simp
        subgoal using destab_opt_infl_stabl_relation[OF Side_Effect(5)]
          by (metis A Inr_not_Inl Side_Effect(1,5) Un_iff equals0D influencing_stabl_after_destab'
              insert_iff list.simps(15) mem_Collect_eq prefix_recorded_in_infl set_append
              set_empty)
        done
    qed
    have "σ state ≤ (σ state)(Inr y := d')"
      apply (intro le_funI)
      subgoal for z
        apply (cases "z = Inr y")
        by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same fun_upd_other Side_Effect(3))
      done
    then have trans_dep_1: "x ∈ insert z (trans_dep⇩L T
      (σ (state⦇infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d')⦈)) z)"
      using mono_trans_dep⇩L Eval.prems(7) by auto
    note IH = Eval.IH(6)[OF Side_Effect(1-5) _ Side_Effect(7) well_infl_stabl _ locale_ub _ less_inv
        trans_dep_1, simplified, OF eq_equal_sides_subsumed Eval.prems(5) pre]
    show ?thesis using IH by auto
  next
    case (Abort)
    then show ?thesis
      using Eval.prems(6) by fast
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis
      using Eval.prems(6) by auto
  qed
qed

lemma less_than_part_post_solution:
  assumes "solve_dom x"
    and "solve x = (st, sigma)"
  shows "∀σl varsl. part_post_solution T x σl varsl ⟶ sigma ≤ σl ∧ st ⊆ varsl"
proof (intro allI impI, goal_cases)
  case (1 σl varsl)
  obtain xd state' where
    iterate_dom: "iterate_dom x (init_state⦇called := insert x (called init_state)⦈)" and
    iterate: "(xd, state') = iterate x (init_state⦇called := insert x (called init_state)⦈)" and
    st: "st = stabl state'" and sigma: "sigma = σ state'"
    using assms unfolding solve_dom_def solve_def by (auto split: prod.splits)
  have "less_than_least x state'"
    using less_than_part_post_solution_ind(2)[OF iterate_dom iterate, of x]
    unfolding init_state_def well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def
    by (auto simp add: le_fun_def)
  then show ?case using 1 by (auto simp add: st sigma)
qed

theorem least_partial_post_solution:
  assumes "solve_dom x"
    and "solve x = (st, sigma)"
  shows "least_part_post_solution T x sigma st"
proof -
  note part_sol = partial_solution[OF assms]
  then have "part_post_solution T x sigma st" by simp
  moreover have least: "∀σl varsl. part_post_solution T x σl varsl ⟶ sigma ≤ σl ∧ st ⊆ varsl"
    using less_than_part_post_solution[OF assms]
    by auto
  ultimately show ?thesis by blast
qed

end ―‹end of context TD_side_opt_mono›
